clean_body: They are crucial to saving our country| | | Peter, If it wasn’t clear before, I think it is now. With Joe Biden and Kamala Harris’ destructive socialist agenda ravaging our country , we NEED a Republican Majority in the Senate to protect us from their worst impulses. A Senate under Republican leadership is possible – but we need top patriots from your state to step up to make it happen. Look, the math is simple. Republicans only need to flip TWO SEATS to take back the Majority, and in 2024 there are THREE Left-wing Democrats up for reelection in REPUBLICANDOMINATED states. Today is the 88th anniversary of Franklin Roosevelt signing the Social Security Act.

## Help us Fund the Police!
---
Fellow American: Are you tired of watching the television and hearing about all the crime in our country? So are we! In the last couple of years we have watched the WOKE left attack our law enforcement agencies and called for the defunding of police. We live in a society where these evil entities have managed to do just that. Many law enforcement agencies have been defunded which has caused the spike in crime across our country. Meanwhile, we have an open border where many “bad hombres” are coming across to destroy our communities. According to the Customs Border Patrol on August 11, 2023 it was reported that Border Patrol apprehended just over 6,000 illegal aliens who crossed into the U.S. illegally, led by RGV sector with 1800+ and Tucson sector with 1700+. These numbers do not include gotaways, port of entry, or CBP One app paroles. In addition, fentanyl deaths are on the rise in the country with no end in sight. Our country is slipping away, but here at Latinos for America First we have decided to partner with the largest Hispanic Organization of Spanish Speaking Officers (OSSO) in Texas and we plan on FUNDING the POLICE. We need your help, these officers are under staffed, over worked, and under paid. We want to show them that we believe and care for them. We support their hard work to keep our communities and families safe. The Organization of Spanish Speaking Officers (OSSO) needs our help funding their Injured Officer Program, their High School Scholarship Program, and all their other Community Initiatives. That’s why we are asking you to help us help OSSO this year. Can we count on you to chip in $50, $100, or $1000 today and help FUND OUR POLICE. Our organization advocates for law and order and that’s why Latinos for America First needs your help. Will you support our efforts and help us fund The Organization of Spanish Speaking Officers! Donate $50, $100 or even $1000 today to help ensure that we keep our officers out on the streets and FUNDED. Mail your check to: 6443 Fairmont Pkwy 140-102 Pasadena TX 77505. Bianca Gracia

#
Please join us this Sunday!
Folks, the backbone of any political campaign is its [volunteers](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=a76ad067c8&e=7017cc100e).

When Dave won in 2020, flipping a long-held Republican State Senate seat here in Orange County, it was largely due to a committed volunteer base, donating their time, talent and treasure, that got him past the post on Election Day. Supporters and volunteers were an essential part of that race's path to victory.

Well, [keeping CA-47 Blue is another difficult project](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=d90ee9a377&e=7017cc100e). That's we're inviting friends and supporters to Irvine this Sunday afternoon for some food and fun, and to communicate volunteer opportunities that are on the horizon. Next year's elections are closer than we think--this will be your opportunity to hear from Dave about what's in store these next few months.

You can (for free) [sign up](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=556eed23fe&e=7017cc100e) using the button below! We'll have plenty of food, and games for the whole family. Please, feel free to circulate this flyer widely within your community--the more the merrier.

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

clean_body: It could be you or your neighbor who suffers the effect of cuts to Social Security if Schweikert has his way | | | | Today marks 88 years since FDR signed the law that established Social Security. It's a testament to the genius and integrity of this policy that retired Americans have been able to count on benefits for nearly a century. Social Security benefits aren't just for seniors, either. In the last four generations, the program has helped countless Americans who've become disabled, supported veterans wounded in the line of duty, and sustained families who've suddenly lost a parent or provider. But to David Schweikert, Social Security means "the end of the Republic." Nearly 1.5 million Arizonans receive Social Security benefits, and Schweikert is working hard to take away their benefits to protect his corporate donors. = = Schweikert gave a long speech last month on the House floor in which he railed against our growing debt – which he blamed on programs like Social Security, and not the irresponsible tax cuts for the wealthiest Americans that he voted for. This isn't new; it's part of a long pattern with Schweikert. He's a member of a House Republican group that released a proposal this summer to raise the retirement age by at least two years and make Social Security less accessible. And back in 2020, he said a familiar line: "Decisions made long ago to create Medicare and Social Security are the primary sources of debt today." There are a lot of things we can do if we're to have a serious conversation about reducing our national debt. But it's telling to me that Republicans like Schweikert always attack a program that helps millions of working people, but never suggest doing something about corporate tax loopholes. As long as he is in Congress, David Schweikert will continue to advance policies that threaten the ability of Americans to retire with ease and dignity. The work to defeat him must start today. = Thank you, Conor | Express Donate: If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly: | = | = | = | = ---|---|---|--- | | | Paid for and authorized by Conor for AZ. |

name: Shamaine Daniels
subject: Are you up?
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/99379/images/ShamaineDanielsbannerforemail.jpg]
Dear Friend,
These days I often have trouble sleeping, and I wonder if you do too.
After I put my daughter to bed I think about her future, and I hope that she will have the opportunities to do and be everything she wants to be. I worry about being a good mom, and a good role model. I think about my job as an attorney, and doing the best I can for my clients who have put their trust in me, and I think about doing all I can for my constituents as a member of City Council.
I'll bet you worry, or at least think, about similar things - your children, your family, your job, and the future.
I believe that government should be an institution that gives us a sense of security and hope. We want to believe that our elected leaders are doing their level best to expand our rights, keep our country safe, and create a world where our children have more and better opportunities.
Unfortunately, that isn't always the case. too often elected leaders, like my opponent Scott Perry, are the source of our anxiety and not a partner in solving the problems we all face.
That's why I'm running for Congress. I want to play an active role in creating that world, and in addressing the things that keep all of us up at night.
Tonight, I'm reaching out to you let you know that if you're worried about those things, you aren't alone. I'm also writing to remind you to have hope. We can create the world we want and the one our children deserve, but we can only do that together.
If you're like me, and dedicated to the same goals, I'm asking you to do two things:
1. We want to know what's keeping you up at night. Complete our survey to tell my campaign and I about the issues that matter most to you. You can take the survey HERE [https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1OM6UOiuiFlY9FETJ_1nWwP9r-3psF1YrMjz4LDFdOGU/viewform?pli=1&chromeless=1&pli=1&edit_requested=true] .
2. Join our team and support the campaign with a contribution ( CLICK HERE to donate now [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023] ). Unfortunately, winning campaigns is expensive, but if we don't win, we can't create the change we want to see in the world.
Thank you for taking the time to read my message tonight, and thank you in advance for taking our survey and making a contribution to our campaign.
Now, go get a good night's sleep and rest a little easier knowing that together we can create the better world we dream about.
Sweet dreams,
Shamaine
If you would like to make a contribution to support the campaign, you can do so using the button below
DONATE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]
P.S. If you missed my announcement video, you can check it out below.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lQXcyDlej8Y [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lQXcyDlej8Y]

Peter,
The rushed and careless rollout of the tolling proposals raises many concerns.

It's time we take a stand and demand that the tolling decision-making process be rooted in openness, thoroughness, and accountability.

_That’s why I’m introducing the_ _**Tolling Transparency Act!**__
_
This groundbreaking legislation will ensure that no major tolling project can proceed without providing the public with a clear understanding of its economic and environmental impacts.

We deserve an Oregon where we are not left in the dark about how these tolls will affect our communities, businesses, and daily lives.

**Here's what the Tolling Transparency Act will achieve:
**
_**Economic Impact Study:**_ Showing ways to mitigate the impact of tolling projects. It will meticulously analyze the effects on local businesses, communities, traffic on city roads, and the well-being of our low-income residents and seniors.

_**Informed Decision-Making:**_ The implementation of tolls would be put on hold until the Economic Impact Study is completed. It's about time we make decisions based on facts, not hasty assumptions.

**Accountability Matters:** Our bill grants the USDOT the authority to put the brakes on any tolling project that could potentially result in an "unreasonable adverse impact."

__**Peter, the Tolling Transparency Act isn't just about tolls.
**__
It's about empowering our communities with knowledge, giving them a voice in the process, and holding decision-makers accountable.

clean_body: | | | | Peter, The rushed and careless rollout of the tolling proposals raises many concerns. It's time we take a stand and demand that the tolling decision-making process be rooted in openness, thoroughness, and accountability. That’s why I’m introducing the Tolling Transparency Act! This groundbreaking legislation will ensure that no major tolling project can proceed without providing the public with a clear understanding of its economic and environmental impacts. We deserve an Oregon where we are not left in the dark about how these tolls will affect our communities, businesses, and daily lives. Here's what the Tolling Transparency Act will achieve: Economic Impact Study: Showing ways to mitigate the impact of tolling projects. It will meticulously analyze the effects on local businesses, communities, traffic on city roads, and the well-being of our low-income residents and seniors. Informed Decision-Making: The implementation of tolls would be put on hold until the Economic Impact Study is completed. It's about time we make decisions based on facts, not hasty assumptions. Accountability Matters: Our bill grants the USDOT the authority to put the brakes on any tolling project that could potentially result in an "unreasonable adverse impact." Peter, the Tolling Transparency Act isn't just about tolls. It's about empowering our communities with knowledge, giving them a voice in the process, and holding decision-makers accountable. | Thank you, Lori Chavez-DeRemer Congresswoman OR-05 | | | | | | | | | Even as a Congresswoman, Lori’s most important title is mom. That’s how she knows the issues your family faces, and that’s why she fights everyday to make life better for every Oregon family, and every American. Aside from that, all you need to know are the issues she’s fighting for in Congress: If that sounds like the kind of agenda you can get behind, If you’d prefer to give by check, please use the below address: Lori Chavez-DeRemer for Congress 13203 SE 172nd Ave Suite 166 #399 Happy Valley, OR 97086 Forward This message to FIVE FRIENDS AND FAMILY to spread the word on how to achieve a better future for Oregon and America → ** Also text “LORI” to 71800 or click here to receive all of Lori’s messages | | | | Lori Chavez-DeRemer 13203 SE 172nd Ave, Suite 166 #399, Happy Valley, OR 97086 \-

This was before I'd even come out publicly.

**After all these years, I can’t think of a stronger rebuke of Calvert's long-standing, anti-LGBTQ agenda than by replacing him with an openly gay prosecutor like Will who will uphold the law and fight for equal rights.**

body:
Please read the following message from our sponsor.

Friend --

My name is Morgan Luttrell.

I'm a combat veteran who served in multiple combat
missions in defense of America.

I've seen things I wouldn't wish on my worst enemy.
Things I will never be able to unsee.

In 2009, I survived a helicopter crash that
should've taken my life but, by the grace of God, I was given a
second chance.

No matter how tough or brave you are, nothing is
fully in your control. That's why we put our faith in God.

But -- there are some things we CAN control, and
that's why I'm running for Congress.

I have to just say it: Biden and the Radical
Democrats want me GONE, they want me DEFEATED, they want to END
my campaign for good.

But unlike the spineless career politicians, I'm
not someone who EVER gives up.

You see, the career DC politicians are living each
day by their own agenda -- not thinking about those suffering the
consequences.

After my time in the military, I knew that each day
that I woke up in America was a gift.

The land of the free and home of the brave.

But the Biden regime has stripped our nation of our
core values and turned us down a path that is leading us toward a
dark future.

So, Friend, I want to humbly ask you right now if
you'll stand with me in my fight for the America we all once knew
and loved.

It is patriots like yourself that have helped
change the direction of our country before, but we still need
you. Maybe now more than ever.

Please, stand up for America's liberties and
freedoms by chipping in just a few bucks today?

CONTRIBUTE

Together, we can bring America back to her
greatness before the Democrats send us further down the dark path
we're currently on.

Thank you,

Morgan Luttrell

body: Standing Strong in Sacremento Today we made history by filing a remonstrance in opposition to AB 957. It has been at least a 100 years since a remon | | [](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5257?id=51315.51.1.d94dc012419f62307fb0447b9de3780d) --- [](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5257?id=51315.52.1.2362ac045ad278bf1091b3c0e5ffd592) | --- ## Standing Strong in Sacremento --- | --- Today we made history by filing a remonstrance in opposition to AB 957. It has been at least a 100 years since a remonstrance as been filled in California. AB 957's purposes would include a parent's affirmation of the child's gender identity or gender expression as part of the health, safety, and welfare of the child. If you deny your child gender reassignment the state would be able to kidnap your child and force them through reassignment therapy. For those that don't know gender reassignment therapy is code for hormone blockers and eventually mutilating the child's sexual organs. In my opinion as a man of God this is a slap in the face to parents, the children who are too young to make this kind of catastrophic decision, and to God. A remonstrance is designed to put the state legislators personally on notice and eventually present the case in front of federal court and the scotus if needed. These new bills that seem to be flying out of our state capitals at an accelerated pace. Most are not even close to following our state or federal constitution. I say personally on notice that means that every Assembly Member and State Senator that votes in favor of AB 957 will be personally liable in the lawsuit that will follow this case. It is time that we stop sitting on the side lines! Get up, stand strong and get in the fight. Stop conplaining and run for office or support a good canidiate. School board, city council, city commissions, just do something. Below you can see the upcoming candidate training in Torrance, this would be a great place to start. You can learn how to run or even learn how to help a camping. ## California Conservative Campaign Development Workshop - Torrance --- ## August 19, 2023 – August 20, 2023 --- | --- The Conservative Campaign Development Workshop is designed to help current and prospective candidates and their supporters identify the steps needed to run a successful campaign. The workshop focuses on campaign strategy, communications, fundraising, voter contact, and election integrity efforts needed to develop a successful campaign. Ideal attendees for the Campaign Development Workshop are individuals who are looking to become more politically active. Candidates, campaign staff, and volunteers involved at any level should attend. Attendees will learn how to: Create a cohesive strategy Communicate a compelling message Ask for money Persuade voters to vote early Organize Election Day (Season) activities Registration includes breakfast and lunch daily. Dena Espenscheid is the best instructor at the Leadership Institute and she is flying to California specifically to provide this training. If you can attend both days that is great. However if you can not, I encourage to spend as much time as you have available. This will entitle you to receive the PowerPoint and any material that is distributed during the Workshop. Meals are also included with the nominal fee. There is lots of free parking available at the Torrance DoubleTree Hotel. [Click For Training!](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5257?id=51315.53.1.e1568d244d27647b0ce3717c62d988ac_ga_52173W50DL*MTY5MTg3NjM0Mi4xLjEuMTY5MTg3NjQ3OC41Ni4wLjA._ga_XK9KHRGLV2*MTY5MTg3NjM0Mi4xLjEuMTY5MTg3NjQ3OS41MS4wLjA.) # Let's have fun and watch the Debate --- ## Presidential Debate Watch Party --- | --- For your information, we will not be having our usual SBCRA meeting for the month of August. Instead of the monthly meeting the board will be hosting a Presidential Debate Party on Aug 23rd. As you know the 2024 election cycle is upon us and it is already debate season. Let's have some fun and make a party for the first 2024 Presidential Primary Debate. This is a party, so let's have lots of fun. Wear your favorite patriotic outfits and bring your fun signs and flags. We will have refreshments and fun party games to make the night even better. We will be hosting the party at 412 Studios in Carson, Right by Ikea and the mall. August 15, 2023 Connecticut Republicans campaigning state-wide or district-wide have usually approached the state's cities with apprehension. That defensive posture has solidified as a result of decades of Democrat and media-echoed propaganda asserting that city residents must depend on the Dems for their survival - an applied 'structural statism.' And that Republicans only exist to either depress minorities, or carve those struggling economically, from their rightful slices of the American pie. Of course, those examining and documenting the conditions within American cities with objective eyes, have demonstrated that propagandized view as a 100 percent inversion of reality. While illumination of the abject failure progressive Democrat policies has been for city residents nationally has gained traction over the past decade, we have not yet broken through in demonstrating that Republican principles and policies are the clear prescription for spurring a renaissance in urban life. A few Republicans have mounted efforts, but usually on single-issue campaigns. But, in just the past couple months two very solid outfits polled working-class city folk for their opinions on a broad range of topics directly affecting their lives. American Enterprise Institute's Survey Center on American Life and the National Opinion Research Center conducted a 6,000 respondent [Survey](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001LHE_yDBVvVo1NNuG2yzhyF12JOlJqVgIBj7e_48SGZywf6YeuIDSZwGt8zJ09ClvAX90x-EviG2PJB7kx_Hkeyb2XxZOkrZkGm3jdNZdoUYseNkPxDg91ypaV4VqlXgBy8VmQMYcJg_FYSizRvckJVxx-tFLmmaVvCILE8I17K6M5mZJqn5588DNNOh26voGjgLbOmbbwikCgKvOPm3u83Tgrj6zlwOXajPc4_tMJszGfp9eSxXghK4BaCy91SQYXPUsfyW7hqtCEesSMS5IsLvYqGrzx7Xpc2s-oLTVzCEI_xmnS0RCig==&c=SD9bGoerCZU9acjS5mRVVkD8Pk6Jnr88hWivt7WiOIVMItQOps_hIQ==&ch=McMBzI_DVy33MFJXZyQdHbcMGRi986JMtgrWTuo9ndnZIHDYI5CXwA==). Or, read the survey author's summarized insights for both Democrat and Republican campaigns here: [Survey Summary](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001LHE_yDBVvVo1NNuG2yzhyF12JOlJqVgIBj7e_48SGZywf6YeuIDSZwGt8zJ09ClvO4wZ_nXHIspiqfM4tKVSoCnrdONKC8KvqrMAB6tZpUwkld9Fq1CWcXC1Yl2hApboELMGrtzKFR4WjKnHu1TJku-eGJ21aRp9DewoA2LEOwM063Xv7AFqwgVzUjlpmygsabkjorJ__NoeRESH7Jpldu2pxMEAjNF1AYdZGAaeNG5jOG9yseK53hVmTd7wptutUkx6z9WbXQst472fDQejLw==&c=SD9bGoerCZU9acjS5mRVVkD8Pk6Jnr88hWivt7WiOIVMItQOps_hIQ==&ch=McMBzI_DVy33MFJXZyQdHbcMGRi986JMtgrWTuo9ndnZIHDYI5CXwA==) The results on key issues may not be too surprising to our conservative instincts, but may in-fact be a revelation to working-class city residents - that Republican policy prescriptions can lead the way from the downward spiral and economic stress being experienced in too many cities today. Following are some insights which illuminate a solid path for the conservative Republican message to make clear inroads with this valuable and critical constituency:
* Public Safety - Crime: When asked whether funding should be reallocated from police departments to social services? 63% of moderate minority working-class voters supported full police dept funding.

* Economic Issues: 72% of moderate minority working-class voters say the Democrats have moved 'too far Left.'

* Cultural / Social Issues: 69% of moderate minority working-class voters say the Democrats have moved 'too far Left.'

* Transgender Athletes in Team Sports: Should Trans-athletes be able to play on sports teams that match their chosen identity? 70% of moderate minority working-class voters said the sports participation should match their birth gender.

* Renewable Energy: When presented with a choice of using a mix of fossil fuel and renewable resources vs. the Democrat approach of phasing out fossil fuels and relying on renewable wind and solar sources? 75% of moderate minority working-class voters support the continued use of fossil fuels.

* School Choice in Education: A separate [Poll](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001LHE_yDBVvVo1NNuG2yzhyF12JOlJqVgIBj7e_48SGZywf6YeuIDSZwGt8zJ09ClveCWj22s_iuF8qjBwj_Z-dJsVuh_WHHvLTyBgFV6n-RZl0jPWojejiOZYd4fAH0fUKq5pZQU2-ipSa6mBN3vrUEMHd5I9GlK6bS2243A2aiL0IpBxP6k7_ftPg3PX4PQdMzALQ6amHGDZ3mEBX_ZCdcb4HpJDMA_E-adj7dC16Lk=&c=SD9bGoerCZU9acjS5mRVVkD8Pk6Jnr88hWivt7WiOIVMItQOps_hIQ==&ch=McMBzI_DVy33MFJXZyQdHbcMGRi986JMtgrWTuo9ndnZIHDYI5CXwA==) conducted by RealClear Opinion Research in July reveals a significant increase in support of school choice across demographics, including Race and Political parties as follows: 66% of Democrats support School Choice; 73% of Black voters support it; 71% of Hispanic voters; 71% of White voters; and 70% of Asian voters.

This recent polling data indicates the current Democrat party is sharply "out-of-touch" with working class Americans - both minority and white. While we don't make such identity and group distinctions - Democrats do. And their insane policies are driving an electorally-determinative voting block into our camp... where we authentically welcome them. On each of the above issues, Republicans embody the successful policy prescriptions, and it is now clear those positions will resonate in the cities. This insight is not lost on my campaign - it will in-fact, be an animating spirit. Over his 14 years in congress, Jim Himes is repeatedly on-the-record, on the wrong side of every one of these critical issues. Democrat Progressivism has failed our cities, and needs to be relegated to the proverbial 'ash heap.' The 'structural-statism' imposed and enforced by Democrat rule in our cities must end. As my campaign develops, I will be happy to be in the 4th District's cities diligently championing solutions which will chart the way forward:
* School Choice
* All-source U.S. energy independence
* Full-funding for public safety
* Parents' Rights in school curricula, sex-ed, & real women in sports
* Traditional family values
* Pro-growth and pro-small business economic policies
* Authentically affordable housing

Our cities can thrive, and the solution lies in policies which incentivize and enable the hard-working people within them, to be free to maximize their talents for the betterment of their communities. The standard of living of our entire continent was raised in record time applying these principles. Surely, we can free up our cities to do the same today! And remember: Jim Himes is NO Moderate
And he proves it every week!
Solid citizens can donate to retire this man right here: [DONATE](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001LHE_yDBVvVo1NNuG2yzhyF12JOlJqVgIBj7e_48SGZywf6YeuIDSZ-lG8LH1KPZV1uk6ye2PfJGAAApotk5O2xSRb13vXjLuxMvdYdyyyR0lG9ZlZGbKYqP9YIRZ3UaBpbjGr-nl9OOnuHwffjrmSkdy_nYE41oQteAKF00UyMIYoEmgavb1KvllJ7D7qq1YRe0Ax_rmeAEbzmcg5pevCRS4obH4Dw9WTFM3PvDe36U=&c=SD9bGoerCZU9acjS5mRVVkD8Pk6Jnr88hWivt7WiOIVMItQOps_hIQ==&ch=McMBzI_DVy33MFJXZyQdHbcMGRi986JMtgrWTuo9ndnZIHDYI5CXwA==) It would be deeply appreciated. Please re-circulate this message to any and all who are interested...or should be. Help is on the way,

# “KLAYMAN: MORE GARBAGE BY CNN: THE COMMUNIST NEWS NETWORK!”

**CNN**
Atlanta-area prosecutors investigating efforts to overturn the [2020 election results in Georgia](https://freedomwatchusa.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=72bc9b8de1fa17e6901eb23e7&id=1652df6e30&e=8edd2b8f7d) are in possession of text messages and emails directly connecting members of [Donald Trump](https://freedomwatchusa.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=72bc9b8de1fa17e6901eb23e7&id=8e9a61ba2a&e=8edd2b8f7d)’s legal team to the early January 2021 voting system breach in Coffee County, sources tell CNN.
Fulton County District Attorney [Fani Willis](https://freedomwatchusa.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=72bc9b8de1fa17e6901eb23e7&id=73fef4124a&e=8edd2b8f7d) is expected to [seek charges](https://freedomwatchusa.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=72bc9b8de1fa17e6901eb23e7&id=bbe9df0920&e=8edd2b8f7d) against more than a dozen individuals when her team presents its case before a grand jury next week. Several individuals involved in the voting systems breach in Coffee County are among those who may face charges in the sprawling criminal probe.
Investigators in the Georgia criminal probe have long suspected the breach was not an organic effort sprung from sympathetic Trump supporters in rural and heavily Republican Coffee County – a county Trump won by nearly 70% of the vote. They have gathered evidence indicating it was a top-down push by Trump’s team to access sensitive voting software, according to people familiar with the situation.

name: James H. Harvey III, American Veterans Center
subject: The first "Top Gun"
body:
| | Please see a special message from our sponsor.
---
| | | | [](http://trk.libertyledger._c291cmNlX2NvZGU9TExPNDIwNTYifQ/eCAx0nm6y7hIpU29x0-byw)
---
Fellow American, I was one of the first "Top Guns" of the U.S. Air Force. In 1949, I was on a small pilot team at the Air Force's first Fighter Gunnery Meet. Over multiple days, we competed against other squadrons in dive bombing, skip bombing, rocket firing, panel strafing, and aerial gunnery at 20,000 and 12,000 feet - _and we won_. But the Air Force listed the 1949 competition winner as "Unknown" for 46 years because our team was composed of Tuskegee Airmen ... and they didn't want people to know we were so good.
---
[](http://trk.libertyledger._c291cmNlX2NvZGU9TExPNDIwNTYifQ/WB7oq7X-VXKCc5T5wcn5rg)
---
_Above: My friends at the American Veterans Center recorded a special video documentary about my military service in World War II and the Korean War._
---
**I** '**m a proud 22-year military veteran who served in World War II and the Korean War with the 33rd Fighter Group, better known as the Tuskegee Airmen.** In addition to being one of the Air Force's first "Top Guns," I was the first African-American combat pilot to fly in Korea, and I went on to fly more than 125 missions there. I'm proud to share my story of patriotism, service, and hard work with the next generation and to see the Tuskegee Airmen I served with recognized for their skill and bravery - after so many years of stonewalling and silence. **I truly understand the importance of recording and sharing veterans** ' **stories so we can honor the men and women who served and inspire young Americans.** That's why, when my friends at the American Veterans Center told me they needed to raise more funds to record veterans' stories - from World War II to today's Special Forces - I knew that I had to take action. [**Can I count on you to chip in $25, $50, $75, $100, $250, $500, or more right now to help support the American Veterans Center** '**s critical work to honor veterans** ' **legacies? As a non-profit organization, AVC depends on support from patriotic Americans like you.**](http://trk.libertyledger._c291cmNlX2NvZGU9TExPNDIwNTYifQ/F_YT-mh3ZjIRo_Cw0X5zIw)
---
[ Support the American Veterans Center](http://trk.libertyledger._c291cmNlX2NvZGU9TExPNDIwNTYifQ/7rmnbnowCCH0pivdmgdRRA)
---
[](http://trk.libertyledger._c291cmNlX2NvZGU9TExPNDIwNTYifQ/5VcsHqRO6aIh2TPujCx6cg)
---
_Above: I was honored to join AVC_ '_s Annual Conference - alongside my fellow Tuskegee Airmen and in the company of hundreds more veterans, students, and military cadets - in Washington, D.C. this year._
---
I was proud to partner with the American Veterans Center for a 37-minute video documentary about my service in World War II and Korea - and also about the Tuskegee Airmen's long journey to rightful recognition for our skill and service. **No other group does as much as the American Veterans Center to safeguard our veterans** ' **legacies and to let our veterans tell their own stories in their own words.** [**That** '**s why I** '**m writing to you today to ask for your support of the American Veterans Center** '**s critical work. Will you make your most generous tax-deductible gift of $25, $50, $75, $100, $250, $500, or more today?**](http://trk.libertyledger._c291cmNlX2NvZGU9TExPNDIwNTYifQ/wedMLNvNcTm0C_ttoV5Nlg)
---
[ Support the American Veterans Center](http://trk.libertyledger._c291cmNlX2NvZGU9TExPNDIwNTYifQ/POKBlE7DoR8E3bQfPwP0Uw)
---
As a young man, I stood outside in my yard and looked up as a formation of P-40 Warhawks flew overhead. In that moment, I knew I wanted to become a pilot. **Today, I hope that my story of serving America - in World War II, in the Korean War, and as one of the first** "**Top Guns" in the Air Force - will similarly inspire the next generation of young people.** Every year, the American Veterans Center reaches _millions_ of Americans through their video documentaries ... their National Memorial Day Parade ... and their Annual Conference for veterans, students, and military cadets. [**Will you join me in supporting the American Veterans Center - and helping them reach even more veterans and young people with their powerful programs - and make a gift of $25, $50, $75, $100, $250, $500, or more right now?**](http://trk.libertyledger._c291cmNlX2NvZGU9TExPNDIwNTYifQ/3qmw64g2yf8qB73Q7Q7CMQ)
---
[ Support the American Veterans Center](http://trk.libertyledger._c291cmNlX2NvZGU9TExPNDIwNTYifQ/h4KvaQB7JvRuhgK45G9eFg)
---
Friend, your support will help the American Veterans Center pass on the lessons of veterans like me - lessons of service, sacrifice, patriotism, duty, and courage. Thank you for helping the American Veterans Center preserve the stories of American heroes so together we can inspire the next generation.
---
[](http://trk.libertyledger._c291cmNlX2NvZGU9TExPNDIwNTYifQ/VLAjDWUz10bRXGwbaVpHpA)
---
Lt. Col. James H. Harvey IIIU.S. Air Force (Ret.)For the American Veterans Center
---
[Support the American Veterans Center](http://trk.libertyledger.)
---

---

| It’s no secret that Vanguard, Fidelity and Charles Schwab could be considered three of the most popular and well-known brokerage firms. Each offers a wide range of products and services, from banking and investment products to financial advisors and financial planning services.

However, there are some important differences, from fees to financial services to research resources, each of which could impact your customer experience. [Learn how these firms stack up so you can decide on the best fit for you.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zpuehrh4d7eocqqv2lp91thkjs4cvs3c6g9pp2bg_rp22sh2s8i66p72chi6aoj4c5h2bs)
### Overview of Vanguard vs. Fidelity vs. Schwab
Vanguard made a name for itself by creating and offering low-fee investment products such as mutual funds and exchange-traded funds (ETFs). It still does this, and even non-Vanguard clients can buy Vanguard funds via a brokerage account. The firm has grown to now offer non-proprietary investment products and funds.

Fidelity is perhaps best known for its personal investment products, namely brokerage accounts that allow users to trade stocks. Clients can invest in a wide range of stocks, bonds and other investment products using a Fidelity brokerage account. Fidelity also makes an effort to provide investment resources to its clients and doesn’t usually charge fees on all trades, though more and more brokerages and broker-dealers are moving toward fee-free investment models.

Schwab has a number of passively and actively managed funds that you can invest your money into. You also have the option to trade individual equities. It also offers free robo-advisor services, and those who want to work with a real advisor will have that option as well. [Learn how the fees compare here.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zem37rn674enqghpn9c16m6d585qa7huogvie41g_rp22sh2s8i66p72chi6aoj4c5h2bs)

### How to Speak With a Financial Advisor

If you’re interested in getting financial advice, consulting a fiduciary financial advisor can be a great first step. That’s why SmartAsset created a [free tool](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zlp8f3meb8aglrjk71dddomn0bl726vpo9ndih18_rp22sh2s8i66p72chi6aoj4c5h2bs) to help match you with up to three financial advisors who serve your area. All advisors on the matching platform have been rigorously vetted through a proprietary due diligence process.

While your advisor matches may not necessarily be associated with the above institutions, research suggests people who work with a financial advisor feel more at ease about their finances and could end up with about 15% more money to spend in retirement.1 It's never too late to work towards a more comfortable retirement.

## Vanguard vs. Fidelity vs. Schwab

---
| It’s no secret that Vanguard, Fidelity and Charles Schwab could be considered three of the most popular and well-known brokerage firms. Each offers a wide range of products and services, from banking and investment products to financial advisors and financial planning services.

However, there are some important differences, from fees to financial services to research resources, each of which could impact your customer experience. [Learn how these firms stack up so you can decide on the best fit for you.](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c21568%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=0gQ13G7HfYBpItgtEbNjhQ&sysid=1)
### Overview of Vanguard vs. Fidelity vs. Schwab
Vanguard made a name for itself by creating and offering low-fee investment products such as mutual funds and exchange-traded funds (ETFs). It still does this, and even non-Vanguard clients can buy Vanguard funds via a brokerage account. The firm has grown to now offer non-proprietary investment products and funds.

Fidelity is perhaps best known for its personal investment products, namely brokerage accounts that allow users to trade stocks. Clients can invest in a wide range of stocks, bonds and other investment products using a Fidelity brokerage account. Fidelity also makes an effort to provide investment resources to its clients and doesn’t usually charge fees on all trades, though more and more brokerages and broker-dealers are moving toward fee-free investment models.

Schwab has a number of passively and actively managed funds that you can invest your money into. You also have the option to trade individual equities. It also offers free robo-advisor services, and those who want to work with a real advisor will have that option as well. [Learn how the fees compare here.](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c21569%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=KKFKQpWQdQB6%2fSlpjEH4Vg&sysid=1)

### How to Speak With a Financial Advisor

If you’re interested in getting financial advice, consulting a fiduciary financial advisor can be a great first step. That’s why SmartAsset created a [free tool](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c21560%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=sKl9cc6%2baUSHErORMjVOjQ&sysid=1) to help match you with up to three financial advisors who serve your area. subject: Two years since Afghanistan
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Hung Cao for Virginia
body:
| | | Fellow Patriot, Today marks the two-year anniversary of Joe Biden’s surrender to the Taliban. Joe Biden sacrificed the lives of eleven Marines, one Sailor, and one Soldier and I will NEVER forgive his dereliction of duty. Afghanistan was relatively stable when I left six months before that day. The fledgling Afghan National Defense Security Forces (ANDSF) that we trained were learning to stand on their own two feet. But Joe Biden destroyed all that hard work. Joe Biden was responsible for the fall of Iraq and the rise of ISIS when he failed to negotiate the Status of Forces Agreement (SOFA) in 2010. I was there and I saw the consequences of his actions. I’ll NEVER forget. In one of his first votes as Senator, Joe Biden voted to stop all funding to the South Vietnamese military causing Saigon to fall. He said the “US has no obligation to evacuate one, or 100,001, South Vietnamese.” I will NEVER stop reminding people of his failures. Joe Biden has abandoned six US embassies in less than three years. Shame on lifelong politicians like Chuck Schumer and Tim Kaine who have supported all of Joe Biden’s failed policies that have weakened our military and damaged the reputation of our nation. I may have put away my uniform, my body armor, my Kevlar helmet, but I will NEVER stop fighting for us. You have my word and where I come from, your word is your bond.

name: Alan Dershowitz
subject: Join the cause of truth
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vsgsvfSDNW

In over sixty years in the legal profession, I've experienced
first hand the impact of both good journalism and bad
journalism....

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/osgsvfSDNW

FROM THE
DESK OF ALAN DERSHOWITZ

Dear
friend,

In over
sixty years in the legal profession, I've experienced first hand
the impact of both good journalism and bad journalism - mostly
the latter - and just how important and rare it is to get things
right.

In
today's media landscape there are far too many publications that
get things wrong. Many are more concerned with the political
implications of a story than the basic facts.

The New
York Sun is different. It's a paper that places principle over
politics and people over party.

Its
in-depth coverage of the legal challenges faced by President
Trump serve as a case in point.

When I
defended President Trump during his first impeachment, I faced an
avalanche of criticism, but few papers made sufficient effort to
fully appreciate the significance of the legal arguments.

The Sun's
deeply knowledgeable leadership, including its editor Seth Lipsky
and associate editor A.R. Hoffman are themselves students of the
Constitution. It shows in their coverage, which I find to be
first rate.

It will
be no secret to you that I don't agree with everything that can
be found in the Sun's pages, but I can say with confidence that
its re-emergence is among the most important recent developments
in American journalism.

I've been
impressed by the Sun's growth so far, but I know it faces an
uphill battle, one that I have pledged to join.

The Sun's
success will be a gift to the American people and to the cause of
truth. But to succeed, we need you to join us. I highly encourage
you to join the Sun today.

Join the
Sun Now →

Every
person matters in this effort.

Don't
wait. The battle to restore American journalism starts now.

Alan
Dershowitz

Columnist, The New York Sun

name: 1600 Daily
subject: Access “C.S. Lewis on Christianity”
body:
C.S. Lewis was a master at addressing life's most important questions

| This sponsored message from 1600 Daily is on behalf of Hillsdale College | | [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2za3muig06p5s6mdscsqb72terec61okja6umjgao_rp22sh2s8i66p72chi61o72c5h2bs)
---
| | Dear friend, C.S. Lewis was a master at addressing life's most important questions through vivid language that is delightful and captivating to read.

His signature ability to communicate the truth about Christianity has inspired countless skeptics to become believers and even more believers to renew and deepen their faith--making him the greatest Christian apologist of the twentieth century.

That's why we produced "[**C.S. Lewis on Christianity,**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z9ui31o8q7uo3p0aie4tum7ak0hei86r2f1ehhl8_rp22sh2s8i66p72chi61o72c5h2bs)" which you can now own on DVD.
---
| [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zb2od75iqitn9hchpmuasq7k8eqh20t9ugpduusg_rp22sh2s8i66p72chi61o72c5h2bs)
---
| | In this course you will learn Lewis's profound insights on the central topics of Christianity, including:
* good and evil,
* conversion and faith,
* prayer and the Bible,
* suffering and death,
* heaven and hell, and much more.

Dr. Ward is a Distinguished Visiting Professor at Hillsdale College and a member of the Faculty of Theology and Religion at the University of Oxford. He is the author of _Planet Narnia: The Seven Heavens in the Imagination of C.S. Lewis_ and _After Humanity: A Guide to C.S. Lewis 's The Abolition of Man_, and the co-editor of _The Cambridge Companion to C.S. Lewis_. He even spent three years living in Lewis's Oxford home as the resident Warden of The Kilns!

This course is especially moving because it examines C.S. Lewis's beautiful writings about faith and traces Lewis's own journey from skeptic to believer. The combination provides an opportunity for us to grow in our knowledge and understanding of Christianity.

That's why I hope you'll join us in examining the eternal questions of Christianity with C.S. Lewis with [this beautiful new DVD box set](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zrrrduilo9mhdramf8g8coejqu55jvf75mpmd8ig_rp22sh2s8i66p72chi61o72c5h2bs).

Best regards,

Kyle Murnen, '09
Director of Online Learning
Hillsdale College
---

---

** Good Morning Republicans,
------------------------------------------------------------
In Joe Biden’s America, Americans are poorer (https://click.campaigns.rnchq.com/?qs=93c505dcc238cecd112b50c6a87d5791cf7aa33c41d606e03fc6adf71889e205ff46505d170a3d9ca428890ad483cd38) , cities and our communities are less safe (https://click.campaigns.rnchq.com/?qs=93c505dcc238cecdd6d621dabdb5a52d38056f4883b1dae97ad2dcfd587bc2696f46eb4c2614d37615f3367e96602ae6) , energy is more expensive (https://click.campaigns.rnchq.com/?qs=93c505dcc238cecda9c1ad746a38caafa7552d71b50c595fc2eefbd6bcc75adcb8eac2eece2199eed3c4a1a0296b9330) , the border is overrun (https://click.campaigns.rnchq.com/?qs=93c505dcc238cecdc9d1ae7e57b4de1be0a71f04d98d77291d4e230613b751c4e3cf99db426f9c5312eda137b0e5dd13) , and our enemies are emboldened (https://click.campaigns.rnchq.com/?qs=93c505dcc238cecd4266894aee9063f4469da4a1b6e10f8424722cda30fcdd508fee9f0aa9e649346ac5582fe6c1a1a5) . Americans cannot afford four more years of Biden and his disastrous policies.

What you need to know:
America is on the wrong track
* 65% (https://click.campaigns.rnchq.com/?qs=93c505dcc238cecd1696e3fabfa88693172b0a2b3828a1429f87b6e98198da5ff53821ee79127b1ff64e282c2a444d57) of the country thinks the nation is on the wrong track.
* In Biden’s America, savings (https://click.campaigns.rnchq.com/?qs=93c505dcc238cecd9d06f9834eaef2f22e886c8c4623a48bd472097b034ee288784b7d4e9b35b8e2dc5c2b2040f0b4f4) are down, incomes (https://click.campaigns.rnchq.com/?qs=93c505dcc238cecd914dc0b4d293498e6b7dc0a6b4a55ff9f088cd41ea0efbf669f9f9e751ae1c91c650ba025cfd34ef) are down, and economic confidence (https://click.campaigns.rnchq.com/?qs=93c505dcc238cecd7a3958b4f82b8caab64c2d1a68eb3b6da13565a164010e84407a5673b6dfa1379e46c14a5dbaee51) is down.
+ 60% (https://click.campaigns.rnchq.com/?qs=93c505dcc238cecd9547eb9348344c76c685b56d33126491771bd7e1b4a3735f17bf113b0af27f9fb302a6fa4bb4a47f) of workers report living paycheck-to-paycheck – including 73 percent of millennials – with more people forced to pick up a side job to make ends meet.
+ Credit card balances are now at an all-time high (https://click.campaigns.rnchq.com/?qs=93c505dcc238cecdcf8c4d9579c7d9c3e2dab6782e8a1a577e2fce7e0a53b53dd0ce88b936d8047d44da25bd1b8198a7) ; topping $1 Trillion
+ 74% (https://click.campaigns.rnchq.com/?qs=93c505dcc238cecdcd4aa81c6fd9df71e8c3b7d31c9434905f200aa15311554d1932c9b27c5431a00befb922d02abf0e) say their financial situation is not improving, with almost half saying their financial situation is actively “getting worse (https://click.campaigns.rnchq.com/?qs=93c505dcc238cecd1886fc4494260de8e8eba4aac58057befef707cbce559b38407ec5c58f2d0ef6c710a6a4260ff142) ” under Biden.

Cost of Living
* Americans are paying the price for Biden’s anti-American energy agenda.
+ On average, Americans have lost over $2,250 (https://click.campaigns.rnchq.com/?qs=93c505dcc238cecdc4906cde7745516c9d22d450aec71da306aa2ee2b80afec644a3821f8afe2dea51ffb616f11cbd05) paying increased energy costs since Biden took office.
+ Gas prices are more than $1 per gallon (https://click.campaigns.rnchq.com/?qs=93c505dcc238cecd139114b705c03b1d8d13830ea74fd795550dc46008adc974909b49ec15c18ef397473c0bae5fcb57) more expensive than when Biden took office, and he has threatened to veto bills (https://click.campaigns.rnchq.com/?qs=93c505dcc238cecde718d420a75a8dccd5d51770a8e398b0c906bb27ef8f66eb5ee2eacbc5b0ae373f307a0d095e817d) that would increase domestic energy production, reform the permitting processes, and unleash American energy.
+ Nearly 20 million households (https://click.campaigns.rnchq.com/?qs=93c505dcc238cecdad5cce30d1d784c4542585198646b2f7107b0bfa687b0163c347d4b505557a040e00040cee891756) are behind on their utility bills.
* Biden’s $1.9 trillion “stimulus” sent (https://click.campaigns.rnchq.com/?qs=93c505dcc238cecd46325b6863550a65c5e3f759c76ba3769585083b6b2ef0d8bbbe9fbca4ee5f38d34d6f6cd9157a30) inflation soaring, with Americans forced to pay higher prices (https://click.campaigns.rnchq.com/?qs=93c505dcc238cecd52b739483efc9e079fe9e8d8bf5665a6a96391d2b5c882613dfefd1f962e639675dbd0b3c19a4599) for virtually everything.
+ Americans have lost over $10,000 (https://click.campaigns.rnchq.com/?qs=93c505dcc238cecdc4906cde7745516c9d22d450aec71da306aa2ee2b80afec644a3821f8afe2dea51ffb616f11cbd05) on average, paying for the increased cost of living since Biden took office.
+ Real weekly wages have fallen nearly every month (https://click.campaigns.rnchq.com/?qs=93c505dcc238cecd0c7074d9be3a3c5ce463067507e13ca41769847a54c6ae04ca435d4b1b5a064dd9d4b055dc893eb3) since Biden and Democrats passed their wasteful $1.9 trillion "stimulus."

Education
* Biden slow walked (https://click.campaigns.rnchq.com/?qs=93c505dcc238cecd1164b2fc07b014a295b5da8b668383a017e994505f24291776e910f90bd304ae1960ef99051755e8) reopening school for months, even letting teachers’ union bosses and major campaign funders (https://click.campaigns.rnchq.com/?qs=93c505dcc238cecd5efc3a4a6d78521626ee13e94b7935a46ba9aaf4e2370913a715d70d9306dbe7b02054ec8304402b) dictate (https://click.campaigns.rnchq.com/?qs=c8f5b14fa6b28b4cdcb99bcad79fcaf68e7ee0b33224d25c84e4e61bbe9d74d47da121178c41e705aab60b432018aa27) CDC guidance.
+ National test results (https://click.campaigns.rnchq.com/?qs=c8f5b14fa6b28b4cca6fb47c97b10e6988618b46ab3da95215484e59b67ac5eb91192329b8355df073538baefed9cb09) in elementary school math and reading have plummeted 5 points in reading and 7 points in mathematics compared to 2020, the largest average score decline in reading since 1990, and the first ever score decline in mathematics.
+ Only 33% and 36% of fourth-graders are proficient in reading and math, respectively.
+ Eighth-graders are worse: 31% were proficient in reading, 26% in math.

Crime
* Last year, at least nine cities (https://click.campaigns.rnchq.com/?qs=c8f5b14fa6b28b4cf27a8cc2b395e519d2100d788b7b5cb950850afca04d0971d3394776d05ea93b8e1129fac683185a) , seven of which are Democrat-run, saw record homicides.
+ In Biden’s first year, at least 12 major U.S. cities – all Democrat-run (https://click.campaigns.rnchq.com/?qs=c8f5b14fa6b28b4ccea7779a3d9ad36dc1257d48a9ddb1949d2b9b7bb312a409a092685b6d91a6ae414e3af77377b6be) – set new homicide records (https://click.campaigns.rnchq.com/?qs=c8f5b14fa6b28b4cbe64726b2396668d43332c8c6e1fe082a8a1e1a57007e8e659b5477ce57febb462115d1dedfc91a6) .

Border
* 7 million (https://click.campaigns.rnchq.com/?qs=c8f5b14fa6b28b4cb20276cf51785a3c18555ba2c6686b4d0a43897c6257435005afc7b0efe0ba1be1c30863a75a76c3) illegal immigrants have crossed the border since Biden took office.
+ This includes the 1.4 million gotaways (https://click.campaigns.rnchq.com/?qs=c8f5b14fa6b28b4c1c4fa8a3530511e295920aa36fa8f76b2db0821711daba8dcf275c4fdbc4d2d998f9558ddab93706) have escaped past Border Patrol into the U.S.
+ Border officials say that the official number (https://click.campaigns.rnchq.com/?qs=c8f5b14fa6b28b4c3e5db842b3363e031a28a6b829a30778cdd9490d1f132d354f12056ed2dbe8b224f21aecdf595cd6) of gotaways vastly undercounts (https://click.campaigns.rnchq.com/?qs=c8f5b14fa6b28b4cfd076007bf7a9d54a0606472d4fb4f5d54b724cefb991966e7350cab531046ef3b0b26932450cb55) the illegal immigrants who make it into the U.S.
* Homeland Security Investigations estimates that Mexican cartels are now making $13 billion (https://click.campaigns.rnchq.com/?qs=c8f5b14fa6b28b4c709ea3ee9054fee56ebd6fcd22ac80a62cbe53207f0e52886692ea9b9006cc322a23404c31118b61) a year smuggling illegal immigrants into the U.S.
* Illicit drugs are flowing into the country at an alarming rate with only 5 to 10% (https://click.campaigns.rnchq.com/?qs=c8f5b14fa6b28b4c5d758eb0b19f50f88fa77f56d5b6395e1c6a613dc86a45153a8996c46a641e3dd26fab9292f9e5de) being intercepted as border officials struggle to contain the smuggling.
+ 2,141 pounds of deadly fentanyl (https://click.campaigns.rnchq.com/?qs=c8f5b14fa6b28b4c241a0c17a1076a95cf429ede73769d01ca41c1e5083bb4970d617b589971933cfa66e01e12506d7c) was seized at the southern border in June alone, with much more getting through.
+ Since Biden took office, more than 21 tons of fentanyl (https://click.campaigns.rnchq.com/?qs=c8f5b14fa6b28b4c02a44cfa91c2028180f5d3ce5c1f6b1f34b1c8e14b7b42d9d3d27aca9a86b94d0a8f772ddf44f5df) have crossed the southern border, enough to kill 9.7 billion people.

The bottom line:
Americans are worse off under Joe Biden and they know it. Republicans offer a vision of prosperity for all, and the Republican primary candidates are campaigning across the country every day bringing their vision directly to the American people, not hiding in Delaware like Joe Biden.

Our Republican presidential candidate along with the other outstanding local Republicans on the ballot in 2024 will need your support, beginning with your financial investment. Nearly one million Cornhusker voters will go to the polls on Election Day 2024 and it is critical for our Party to make sure they are not misled by Biden’s lies and the radicals’ propaganda.

With your financial support today, you’ll fund the grassroots operation, yard and barn sign campaigns, door-to-door literature blitzes, targeted mailings to key voter blocs (farmers, ranchers, veterans, seniors, gun owners, pro-life activists, pastors and business owners).
Republicans, Nebraska needs you!

With much blessings,
–Chairman Underwood

** Spotlight Feature: From Rep Dave Murman
------------------------------------------------------------
Decline to Sign
Statement from Senator Dave Murman

Every parent and child in Nebraska should have the right to pick a school they believe best suits their unique situation. The Opportunity Scholarships Act passed this last session in the Legislature provides this much needed choice for Nebraska’s children. This is long overdue in Nebraska as 48 states provide this choice for their parents and children.

Yet, just as Nebraska is progressing forward with the times, a well-funded petition group has organized paid petitioners to seek the repeal of this bill and send us backwards. They claim that this bill will drain revenue from public education even as this session approved 305 million dollars in extra funding for our public schools. A one-billion-dollar Education Future Fund was also created in order to deal with any future funding issues. You can clearly see that the Legislature carefully planned for public education funding and increases it!

In Nebraska we love our public schools and our schools, teachers and students are always on the honor roll when academic performance is considered. We can continue this great tradition AND move forward, allowing parents and the children to seek the education they believe is best tailored to them. In a liberty loving nation like the United States this should not be controversial.

Yet, even as the vast majority of our schools and school districts perform at a high level, sometimes our children can fall between the cracks or a school or school district can under perform. The Opportunity Scholarships Act allows parents and the children the choice to find another school; public or private. Priority is given to low-income families and this scholarship will fully cover their expenses at the school of their choice and allow them the academic freedom which should be assumed in this nation.

| | | Dear Friend, Your participation in Hillsdale College’s **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court** is requested.

Your response will only take a few minutes, but the subject is crucial to the future of liberty and the separation of powers in America.

The American Founders thought that the proper role of the Supreme Court is to apply the Constitution.

But progressives see the Court differently. They want activist judges to legislate from the bench.
## Do you agree that the role of the Supreme Court is to apply the Constitution as it is written and NOT to make laws or advance a particular policy agenda?
[YES](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zgm7g64rjlh68760f043kledd1h2ibnlmupiaa0g_rp22sh2s8i66p72chi61o72cth2bs) [NO](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zi8d6shhqalpjtnnu9qu8bsio3vjufffo2ia88kg_rp22sh2s8i66p72chi61o72cth2bs) Even worse, progressives dismayed by recent Supreme Court decisions want to “pack” the bench with additional justices to advance a preferred policy agenda.

As Sen. Elizabeth Warren (D-Mass.) put it in a _Boston Globe_ op-ed: “To restore balance and integrity to a broken institution, Congress must expand the Supreme Court by four or more seats.”

That is why I’m reaching out to you today...

_What is your opinion about the Supreme Court’s role in our constitutional republic? _

Please share your thoughts with me using the College’s **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court** right away.

Your response will help Hillsdale form effective strategies to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the proper role of an independent judiciary that applies the Constitution instead of legislating from the bench.

You can easily complete your **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court** using this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/supreme-court-survey](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zt56b3l7cmrq42hrqj0pba3mpt0npfibrssjhsu8_rp22sh2s8i66p72chi61o72cth2bs)** Thank you for your time and attention—and for your support of liberty.

subject: My opponent is celebrating initiatives he opposed
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY THE FRIENDS OF DR
body:
Friend,
This is fascinating, but typical of my opponent, Jack Bergman. He recently shared his "involvement" [https://www.facebook.com/RepJackBergman/posts/pfbid02LSuTjGvmEe3LMRRUTWfYp8mA9MwkduRk6FyXcu4mReGpQCnUuRnXoQm6umuu96Kul] in a photo op celebrating electronics manufacturing and jobs in the district, an opportunity for the Congressman to show he cares about science and employment.
It's a great industry working toward a great cause - getting students jobs.
One major problem...
Jack Bergman's voting record shows he opposes it.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob]
➤ CONTRIBUTE TO DEFEAT BERGMAN ➤ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob]
Just as Rep. Bergman has a knack for taking credit for bills he voted against, voters should remember he voted against the bipartisan CHIPs and Science Act, which directly benefited our district with jobs in the semiconductor manufacturing field.
The hypocrisy is astounding.
, can you help me get the word out? A recurring contribution of $5, $50, or even $500 will help us inform voters of Bergman's abandonment of working family values. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob]
We cannot allow his photo ops to be louder than his voting record.
I'm regularly using my platform to expose my opponent's abysmal record, but I need you in my corner to fund our efforts. Can you pitch in to help me reach more voters and inform them that their so-called representative is voting against their interests?
U.S. tech innovators invented semiconductors, but domestically the Nation only manufactures 12% of the supply. Asia produces over 75%. Earlier this year, Calumet Electronics, one of a few American manufacturers producing components for microelectronics, announced an expansion creating 80 jobs in the Keweenaw Peninsula.
I support "Made-In-Michigan manufacturing, good jobs, and working families in the 1st District.
Jack Bergman owes hardworking families of the 1st District an explanation. Why did he vote against good-paying jobs? Why didn't he support improving national security? When they needed him, he opposed this industry and voted against its investment.
When he needed these companies for a photo op, Bergman proudly shared it on his social media, despite being the obstacle standing in the way of their success.
Help me have a big day of fundraising to show he can't keep getting away with this. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob]
Thank you for your consideration.
-Dr. Bob
Bob Lorinser
Candidate for US Congress

Democrat, MI01

August 15, 2023
“Former New Jersey Gov. Chris Christie (R) has surpassed Florida Gov. Ron DeSantis (R) in the critical early presidential primary state of New Hampshire, according to a new Emerson College survey released on Tuesday.
“Christie leapfrogged DeSantis’s second place in the Granite State, garnering nine percent support. DeSantis’s support, on the other hand fell to eight percent from 17 percent in March. Christie’s one-point lead over DeSantis falls within the poll’s plus or minus 3.4 percent margin of error.
“Christie’s campaign has maintained an intense focus on New Hampshire, while DeSantis’s team has prioritized Iowa. However, DeSantis has still made a number of trips to the Granite State. ...
“The Emerson College Poll was conducted August 9-11 among 837 registered voters in New Hampshire.”

subject: I'm sweating
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Booker for Kentucky
body:
[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/19018?t=1001&akid=3497%2E346206%2Eihiati ][IMG]

I'm sweating, Peter.

And it's not just because of the Texas heat. It's because August has been
really slow for fundraising.

I know, we just reported our record-breaking fundraising numbers and
everyone from CNN to FiveThirtyEight says we can win this race.

But our incredible start to this race makes me one of the Republican's top
targets in 2024.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/19018?t=1002&akid=3497%2E346206%2Eihiati ]Peter, we can't afford to fall short on this (or any)
fundraising goal if we're going to power this campaign to victory and
bring real change to Texas. So please, split a donation of $25 or whatever
you can spare between my campaign and Charles Booker to help me defeat Ted
Cruz. →

Unlike Cruz, I'm not counting on wealthy donors to buy this seat for me
because I believe our leaders should be accountable to the people they
serve, not special interests.

And listen, Texas is huge – it takes over 11 hours to drive from the
Panhandle to the southernmost point.

That means we need way more volunteers, pamphlets, folks knocking doors,
and yard signs to win in Texas than it does in other states. And that adds
up fast.

So I'm counting on folks like you to step up with $5, $10, or whatever you
can spare, to power our massive grassroots campaign and help create the
change we know Texans want and need.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/19018?t=1003&akid=3497%2E346206%2Eihiati ]Right now, I'm counting on you to help me raise $50,000 by midnight to
get back on track. So please, will you split a donation between my
campaign and Charles Booker and help me fire Ted Cruz? →

Thank you so much – and in all seriousness, I hope you are keeping cool
amid record-breaking temperatures this summer!

Colin Allred

Friend,
We are living through the darkest chapter of American history.
We are watching the ruling regime try to IMPRISON its opposition. Nothing like this has ever before happened in America.
I will continue to speak out against the disturbing downfall of our once great country – but there’s one thing you will _**NEVER**_ hear me say...
**...You will never hear me feel sorry for myself. You will never hear me lose hope in our country.**
_As dark as these days may be, our national history is filled with peaceful patriots who REFUSED to give up even during the toughest times imaginable._
There were many times when the cause of our Founding Fathers looked bleak. The odds were certainly not in their favor.
They were standing up to the largest empire the world had ever seen.
Imagine if in 1775, the Founders decided that their mission was impossible and so they dropped to their knees and surrendered their noble quest for freedom. America never would’ve existed.
But they didn’t give up. Because they embodied that age-old adage: “ _I’d rather die on my feet than live on my knees.”_
The truth is: nothing great in life ever comes easily – _and what could be greater than reclaiming our American Independence from a corrupt, self-serving regime that attempts to imprison its opposition?_
**When I chose to run against the ruling class as a complete political outsider, I knew what I was getting myself into.**
I knew that the Deep State would use the full weight of the federal government to try and take me down.
_But the Deep State made one massive mistake..._
...They didn’t realize that they wouldn’t just have to take _me_ down, but the millions and millions of hardworking Americans who refuse to surrender our country as well.

Together, we have defied every narrative, we have outsmarted the so-called experts, and we have _trumped_ the special interest globalist donors.
So, let me once again say to all our haters and enemies who want to put me BEHIND BARS for the rest of my life as an innocent man – _**I WILL NEVER SURRENDER OUR MISSION.**_
We will prevail against these vicious witch hunts.
We will win back the White House.
We will save America from tyranny.
And we will MAKE AMERICA GREAT AGAIN! 🇺🇸🇺🇸🇺🇸

subject: Democracy wins in Michigan AND Ohio again (and again)
disclaimer_text:

Jocelyn Benson for Secretary of State
body:
Democracy in Michigan keeps getting stronger. Since I took office in 2018, we’ve seen voters amend our constitution three (!) times to expand and guarantee voting rights for every citizen and put people, not politicians, in charge of drawing our state’s legislative and congressional districts.
Michiganders have shown the country that by organizing and amending our state constitution we can make democracy stronger than over. That’s why it was incredible to see Ohio politicians try to make it harder for their state’s citizens to amend their constitution over the summer - and fail spectacularly after Ohioans rejected their cynical, dishonest plot in a statewide vote last Tuesday.
In rejecting a ballot measure that would have made it more difficult for Ohio citizens to amend their own state’s constitution, Ohio voters showed the country: when politicians try to defeat democracy, democracy will prevail.
In fact democracy will always prevail when citizens come together - across party lines and other divisions - to ensure every voter knows that only they can save it. That’s what history teaches us, that’s our Michigan story, and that’s what Ohio showed the nation last Tuesday.
That’s why I started Michigan Legacy PAC - to preserve the pro-democracy work we’ve done together and expand and fortify it in the years ahead. Support our effort today >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michiganlegacypac?refcode=081423]

There’s much work ahead of us, but I know our efforts will continue to succeed if we keep working together.
Onward,
Jocelyn

| | Americans are over it, my friend. **Hell, I'm over it. ** Nearly every time I scroll through the news, Donald Trump is taking up the headlines and stealing the spotlight with all of his baggage and another indictment. But here's the thing, that's not what Americans are worried about. I like to say, _**the audio and the video need to match**_... and when it comes to the headlines versus what the polls show, they're not matching up.
---
[](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=34d89e461aaa44c78b8907f4a4a14a11&_m=a8ac4d2286d143b688f6c25cd9069357&_e=Qqi3mue5w3-4ZlJIYKXBWg3T_UzDnfQczPZwtZPnnj1Xu0J_FnURNODWAeiJJdYGa2BSslvG4z5B6247h9D4f9_cDdcDsWb7uDvVUv8pSKopKG4gIIafsGnHuSGVMxlp7j79E_xMbQwaCCHBfQfYGu4YOOBsr93iUOstsUobSGdtUjDHqIctBukBVbUYghoSIDsj92pWTW1t1KREtVKORoRdOckvlwrDYODKwKXsTVlPeGYjbdvOEoJCrrPpQGjTVThB6TBJUdz4qYdU1wuzyrB1QycnU_Wpe4wMCkqHP7Bkm59bK1FPXCt8cH3PYYjUpVa3UVsPRHh5Bdqd1JBHiSMvD6nIDQeVtZUD1GIDzrab5cz0FMyiCne9vA2707maogb2hhDSIkQQ-b9lJyclEA%3D%3D)
---
_**Polls show that Americans are worried about putting food on the table, providing healthcare for their family, living in safer communities, and fixing immigration to secure our nation.**_ They do not care about Donald Trump's ongoing issues with the law. So why are we allowing him to distract us from addressing the real issues? We're building momentum and showing that the American people want to see a solutions-based campaign, not a campaign based on problems. **[Help me stay the course and get on the debate stage to talk about the issues that are being ignored by donating $1.](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=34d89e461aaa44c78b8907f4a4a14a11&_m=a8ac4d2286d143b688f6c25cd9069357&_e=Qqi3mue5w3-4ZlJIYKXBWg3T_UzDnfQczPZwtZPnnj1Xu0J_FnURNODWAeiJJdYGa2BSslvG4z5B6247h9D4f9_cDdcDsWb7uDvVUv8pSKopKG4gIIafsGnHuSGVMxlp7j79E_xMbQwaCCHBfQfYGu4YOOBsr93iUOstsUobSGdtUjDHqIctBukBVbUYghoSIDsj92pWTW1t1KREtVKORoRdOckvlwrDYODKwKXsTVk0x3Tc7v_cZrb7PoX3scaNFTWlgtAz-BTcqUyvfQoQ5UXULuTleJkLfEb9oTasWqHI3KW0eKx3PDTJWSgTMgFE3JnhCQ3q3BjEusnF2r_C8lUQ-89OBVWUM1xa0bgtXSLmB9QuCeYdLfLliXL4yB6nEVuZVU7TScJYR6oSyXTmWA%3D%3D)** _**I can't do this alone. Nearly every time I scroll through the news, Donald Trump is taking up the headlines and stealing the spotlight with all of his baggage and another indictment. But here's the thing, that's not what Americans are worried about. I like to say, the audio and the video need to match... and when it comes to the headlines versus what the polls show, they're not matching up. Polls show that Americans are worried about putting food on the table, providing healthcare for their family, living in safer communities, and fixing immigration to secure our nation. They do not care about Donald Trump's ongoing issues with the law. So why are we allowing him to distract us from addressing the real issues? We're building momentum and showing that the American people want to see a solutions-based campaign, not a campaign based on problems. I can't do this alone. I need you on my six. Thanks, Will Hurd | | | | www.hurdforamerica.com | | |

Team -
It’s August 15th, and tonight marks the official mid-point of our quarter. So I am reaching out to you personally with an update on our mid-quarter fundraising progress.
When my team emailed you yesterday about our mid-quarter deadline, we weren't quite sure how much support we would get — or whether we'd reach our goals ahead of tonight's critical fundraising drive.
But we have a solid chance.
It started with Michele from Wauwatosa with a $20 donation. Then Rosalind from New York joined with their $100. And later, Scott from Concord chipped in $3.
Now they're all hoping that you will join them, and I am too. Because there's only one way we'll continue powering our movement for changemaking candidates...if we work together.
I know that $3 doesn't seem like the kind of money that can help us hold the Senate majority and Presidency and win back the House, but this team has won big victories before — in the Wisconsin Supreme Court Race and the Virginia State Senate race — and I have no doubt we can do it again.

However, there are some important differences, from fees to financial services to research resources, each of which could impact your customer experience. [Learn how these firms stack up so you can decide on the best fit for you.](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=114bb2e926d74e388c9a172f147feb09&_e=QiwHWfUdHZgq1WmcPk0RgG9QQw9J8QfO8O0ctlgpmgeiP1fts0aWQ_3chGBxyWFCInjs2SKvvlcLi38UdF4x3-aynIjJxRXxUJXe5a9ZRr9wuVJz9s9qyu0FbPcNm4nXvfTlgTAjU5JApMfzUAngyrq7IZH9ajY95H0QOfceAo7KcvKQTHX9JQfpUmxj32fnnFIqyVyK-IXO6KaU_69QMnMfSkW0Ec5RsMY6HaILbQQ6t_59_xyYAhAUj6Pu8pJ9J7WO_RGduc1gX-qpef33irMa3rRetp2CrPBxnG2KwPbWmOHvJmf7E9Jqg4U6i1JuArxdAyUJLk6nPdXMNSKgi-yGJRSSiSQVP3zMp-T54kNSEhv6KSrVRf6Gp6l7qkVE_NdH-seB0uztzecyQ3jhiuwnenN4-eQG_tO3AcId16oAWZxIiLqykbjS4kQHAkOECVvHZQSlVZg8b2soB-JgvsDzQZ25Z4DWg13I1uOhkrk%3D)
### Overview of Vanguard vs. Fidelity vs. Schwab
Vanguard made a name for itself by creating and offering low-fee investment products such as mutual funds and exchange-traded funds (ETFs). It still does this, and even non-Vanguard clients can buy Vanguard funds via a brokerage account. The firm has grown to now offer non-proprietary investment products and funds.

Fidelity is perhaps best known for its personal investment products, namely brokerage accounts that allow users to trade stocks. Clients can invest in a wide range of stocks, bonds and other investment products using a Fidelity brokerage account. Fidelity also makes an effort to provide investment resources to its clients and doesn't usually charge fees on all trades, though more and more brokerages and broker-dealers are moving toward fee-free investment models.

Schwab has a number of passively and actively managed funds that you can invest your money into. You also have the option to trade individual equities. It also offers free robo-advisor services, and those who want to work with a real advisor will have that option as well. [Learn how the fees compare here.](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=114bb2e926d74e388c9a172f147feb09&_e=QiwHWfUdHZgq1WmcPk0RgG9QQw9J8QfO8O0ctlgpmgeiP1fts0aWQ_3chGBxyWFCInjs2SKvvlcLi38UdF4x3-aynIjJxRXxUJXe5a9ZRr9wuVJz9s9qyu0FbPcNm4nXvfTlgTAjU5JApMfzUAngyrq7IZH9ajY95H0QOfceAo7KcvKQTHX9JQfpUmxj32fnnFIqyVyK-IXO6KaU_69QMnMfSkW0Ec5RsMY6HaILbQQ6t_59_xyYAhAUj6Pu8pJ9J7WO_RGduc1gX-qpef33irMa3rRetp2CrPBxnG2KwPbWmOHvJmf7E9Jqg4U6i1JuArxdAyUJLk6nPdXMNSKgi3DWxP6_moFjE6Sj3WcQ-8j2qGsfCmSGcoruO6Nwu65BdFwalZAZPq5NKuxSNRXdr9gOIh9f7zDkkt9EF5unNkBnBipmlpvw9clIpmfNI8jOrk-2MMSywNJ3edLMzNRkweGKJQOr8k2r4-E6h0ok7l8%3D)

**FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE:** August 15, 2023
Contact: [press@tellitlikeitispac.com](mailto:press@tellitlikeitispac.com)
**Round 6 Of Tell It Like It Is PAC’s 10 Reasons Donald Trump Is Afraid to Debate**
**ARLINGTON, VA —** Today, Tell It Like It Is PAC released the sixth ad in a ten-part video series highlighting Donald Trump’s unwillingness to commit to the first Republican National Committee (RNC) debate on August 23rd. Round Six takes Trump to task for breaking his promise to balance the budget and [eliminate](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=db835a245b&e=d0a9afa930) the national debt. Instead, Trump’s free-spending ways added [trillions](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=f9d6e47a6a&e=d0a9afa930) to the national debt, amounting to over [$23,000](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=3a7cbcd659&e=d0a9afa930) in new federal debt for every American.
Conversely, Governor Christie [inherited](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=eb0425748f&e=d0a9afa930) an $11 billion deficit on a $29 billion budget and balanced the budget without raising taxes.
The underlying message behind the digital campaign is clear: Donald Trump is afraid to debate because he knows that Governor Christie will bring the fight directly to him. Unlike the other candidates in the race, Governor Christie is not afraid to prosecute his failures and disqualifying behavior.

name: Gavin Newsom
subject: ❗OFFICIAL❗– California released our resolution calling for a Constitutional Convention on gun violence. Add your name as a citizen-co-sponsor today.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY CAMPAIGN FOR DEMOCRACY PAC
body:
Here is part of the official language I am asking you to say you support:

Friends —
When I proposed a Constitutional Amendment to make our communities safer from gun violence, I told you that California would be the first state to take the action necessary to make it happen.
The time has come.
Yesterday afternoon, the legislature introduced the official language calling for a national Constitutional Convention on gun violence.
Soon, our legislators will vote. Everyone will be watching. So before they do, I want you to take a small and simple action that will send a powerful message about the grassroots support for this idea:
[**Add your name as a Citizen Co-Sponsor of California's language calling for a Constitutional Amendment to make our communities safer from gun violence:**](https://act.gavinnewsom.com/signup/em-cosponsor-ca-28th/?source=em230814-1-f&refcode2=1537.4767699.Da2_6W&akid=1537%2E4767699%2EDa2_6W)
[ADD YOUR NAME](https://act.gavinnewsom.com/signup/em-cosponsor-ca-28th/?source=em230814-1-f&refcode2=1537.4767699.Da2_6W&akid=1537%2E4767699%2EDa2_6W)
Here is part of the official language I am asking you to say you support:
Impose, as a matter of national policy, the following firearms regulations and prohibitions: (a) **universal background checks** as a prerequisite to purchase or acquisition of a firearm, (b) a **prohibition on sales, loans or other transfers of firearms to those under 21 years of age** , subject to limited exceptions, (c) **a minimum waiting period after purchase** or acquisition of a firearm before that firearm may be delivered to the buyer or acquirer, and (d) a **prohibition on private possession of assault weapons** and other weapons of war.
If neither Republicans in Congress nor the courts will take action to help make our communities safer from gun violence, then we — the people — must do it ourselves.
Convening a constitutional convention requires 34 state legislatures to call for this.
It starts with one, and California will be the first.
Will finding 33 more states who will call to amend the Constitution be easy? No, of course not, I am clear-eyed about that.
But it starts with demonstrating national, grassroots support for this idea. So I am asking:
[**Use this link to add your name as a Citizen Co-Sponsor of California's language calling for a Constitutional Amendment to make our communities safer from gun violence:**](https://act.gavinnewsom.com/signup/em-cosponsor-ca-28th/?source=em230814-1-f&refcode2=1537.4767699.Da2_6W&akid=1537%2E4767699%2EDa2_6W)
[ADD YOUR NAME](https://act.gavinnewsom.com/signup/em-cosponsor-ca-28th/?source=em230814-1-f&refcode2=1537.4767699.Da2_6W&akid=1537%2E4767699%2EDa2_6W)
Thank you,
Gavin Newsom
