body:
For millions like me, DACA is not enough. | | | Hi Peter, my name is Aurora. 👋
11 years ago today, DACA applications started being accepted. Since then, hundreds of thousands of immigrant youth have benefitted from the program by their ability to work, go to school, and live free from the fear of deportation. In the 11 years since that day, DACA has been through attack after attack — and is currently in legal limbo as we wait on yet another ruling from Texas conservative Judge Hanen’s court. **** I applied for DACA in 2021 — just as Judge Hanen’s first decision against DACA stopped new applications like mine from being processed. **That means I’m one of the nearly 400,000 people who are eligible for DACA, but currently unable to apply.** Not having DACA has made life an everyday struggle for me and my family. Everything from being able to find work or make ends meet, to accessing health care and higher education is affected by not having DACA. **When DACA applications started being accepted 11 years ago, it was a massive win for our community. But now, for myself and millions like me, DACA is not enough.** Whether we were blocked from the program by Judge Hanen or ineligible to begin with, only permanent protections will make us feel safe and give us opportunities to thrive. Permanent protections would mean I’m no longer in constant fear of being deported. I could continue my studies, help support my family, and not worry if there will be food on the table. I could do great things without the limitations of being undocumented and unprotected. 🧡 A pathway to citizenship for ALL undocumented people, including me and my parents, is the only true solution. The anniversary of DACA’s first applications is also a reminder of the power our community has to win real change. Activists and allies fought relentlessly to win DACA, and we’ll need to come together again to win permanent protections. **Peter, will you join me and UWDA as we work toward permanent protections? | A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health. In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular. Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities: Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates, Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities, Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT, Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable, Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency, Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation, Turning Florida into a model for election integrity, Protecting the unborn, Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state, Expanding education freedom, Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities, Lowering prescription drug costs, Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable, Creating a universal school choice program, Delivering record-breaking tax relief, Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership, Supporting law enforcement and our veterans, Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders, Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court, ...and so much more. After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes. But history didn't stop there: Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points. Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall. Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women. Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism." Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history. | That’s the fourth indictment this year for the twice-impeached ex-president.
# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=3400%2E5257348%2EDsXh7u)
Derek — I’m writing to you with an urgent update:
**A grand jury in Fulton County, Georgia has just indicted Donald Trump... yet again. That’s the fourth indictment this year for the twice-impeached ex-president. This one coming from District Attorney Fani Willis in her investigation of Trump’s efforts to overturn the Georgia election result in 2020.**
Let me be clear: This indictment, like the one returned by a federal grand jury in Washington, DC a short time ago, closely tracks the evidence we uncovered during the January 6 Select Committee’s investigation. And I led the hearing that examined Trump’s conduct in Georgia, revealing much of this evidence.
Trump is charged with a sprawling racketeering enterprise, in which he sought to overturn the election in Georgia and other key battleground states. The new indictment lays out, in graphic detail, many of the overt acts in furtherance of his plot to hold onto power after losing the election.
This case is powerful. And will rely on Trump’s own words, including those that he uttered on the infamous phone call to Georgia’s Secretary of State:
“All I want to do is this. I just want to find 11,780 votes, which is one more than we have because we won the state.”
“So what are we going to do here, folks? I only need 11,000 votes. Fellas, I need 11,000 votes. Give me a break.”

Today at 3 p.m. EST, our Communications Director Greg Price, Riley Gaines, Tom Jones from American Accountability Foundation (AAF), and I will be hosting a Twitter Space to discuss the American Library Association (ALA).
You can join through the link right here: [https://twitter.com/greg_price11/status/1691449656105177088?s=20](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/fe03f3e8-292b-4005-a884-4739bc9798e4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
We have written at length in our previous emails about the war state Freedom Caucuses have launched against the ALA. They recently elected a self-described "marxist lesbian" to lead their organization. They support drag queen story hours for children while fighting to stop Kirk Cameron events from being held at public libraries. They vocally support porn in school libraries and even once gave an award to George Soros.
Read the [full report](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/14782508-3bb9-4e30-80aa-cd187bb343ca?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) from AAF on their left-wing bias.
And the ALA does it all while being the backbone of our nation's library system and receiving thousands of tax dollars from state governments. That's why state Freedom Caucuses are now fighting to get state and local library associations to put an end to it.
Join us on the Twitter Space today as we discuss this very important topic that isn't getting nearly enough attention.
**Keep fighting,**

**Andy Roth**

body:

|
---
# Water Quality:
# A Top Priority for
# Michigan's Future
|
---
As we journey towards a better future for Michigan's 4th District, I'm thrilled to highlight a crucial campaign issue: water quality.
Today, I share with you my commitment to ensuring clean and safe water for all residents in our beloved district.
Water is vital to our communities' health and well-being.
Access to clean, safe water is a fundamental right for every Michigander.
| [LEARN MORE](https://alfonsoforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bb75364011dcc8a637f1fdd6f&id=e45e716326&e=16d812e81c)
---
|
---
# Protecting Our
# Lakes and Rivers
|
---
Michigan's 4th District has breathtaking lakes and rivers that are not only sources of natural beauty but also critical resources for our communities. I am dedicated to preserving the purity of our water bodies, safeguarding them from pollution and harmful practices.
By supporting responsible environmental policies, we can ensure that future generations can enjoy these waters as we do today.
I recognize the importance of investing in infrastructure projects for improved water treatment, lead protection, and access to safe drinking water.
By advocating for stronger regulations and clean alternatives, we create a safer environment for our communities.
Your involvement and input are invaluable as we address water quality issues.
Together, we can build a healthier, sustainable future.
|
---
# EVERY DOLLAR
# COUNTS!
|
---
| [GIVE TODAY](https://alfonsoforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bb75364011dcc8a637f1fdd6f&id=09896d3945&e=16d812e81c)

Your support is essential in driving our mission to improve water quality and protect our environment.
By contributing you shape policies prioritizing community well-being and natural resource preservation.
Visit alfonsoforcongress.com and click "Give Today" to contribute securely.
Every donation, big or small, makes a difference.
Thank you for believing in our cause.
Together, we'll build a Michigan that works for everyone, reflecting the spirit of democracy.
With heartfelt gratitude,
Alfonso For Congress Team

Justice and the rule of law are officially DEAD in America.
A left-wing prosecutor - _with such extreme anti-Trump bias that EVEN CNN questioned her legitimacy _- has **INDICTED** me despite having committed NO CRIME.
This marks the **FOURTH ACT** of Election Interference on behalf of the Democrats in an attempt to keep the White House under Crooked Joe's control and **_JAIL_** his single greatest opponent of the 2024 election.
_**Let me remind you that just days before I announced my 2024 presidential campaign** , **Crooked Joe declared on national TV that serious efforts would be taken to stop me from being able to "take power" again.**_
We're watching those efforts unfold as Crooked Joe's henchmen follow their boss' orders by targeting me in baseless witch hunts in an attempt to JAIL ME FOR LIFE as an innocent man.
The left-wing prosecutor orchestrating this latest witch hunt for Crooked Joe was caught "intermix[ing] her political fortunes with this case."
_**Her bias was so terrible that she had to be REMOVED from one part of the case because of a "political conflict of interest" of her own creation.**_

**Even the Fake News called her media circus show a "HORRIBLE IDEA" and a "prosecutor's nightmare."**
Our once free Republic where citizens were presumed innocent until proven guilty is gone.
In its place is a Marxist Third World dictatorship led by an incompetent yet crooked tyrant who tries to place your fate in the hands of vengeful and corrupt prosecutors.
_Communism has finally reached America 's shores._
But while these certainly are dark times for our country, I will NEVER give up on America.
The more I see these rogue prosecutors weaponize our legal system to criminalize dissent and imprison their political opponents, the _stronger_ my resolve to save our country.
Because I know that if these illegal persecutions succeed, if they're allowed to set fire to the law, then it will not end with me... They'll come for YOU.
America is the greatest nation in history - and I WILL **NEVER SURRENDER** our country to these radical tyrants who seek to destroy it.
**Even after _4_ sham indictments and a threat of HUNDREDS OF YEARS IN PRISON, I will never abandon our mission, because the fate of our nation hangs in the balance in the 2024 election. It's not just my freedom on the line, but yours as well - and I will _NEVER_ let them take it from you.**
_If you are doing poorly right now due to the very sinister people who are ripping our country to shreds, then just hit the back button and go about your day. I seriously mean it! _
But if not, I don't have to tell you that the stakes of this election have never been greater. Our Republic is hanging by a thread, and America needs you right now.

Friend, I enjoy real debate. I think the insults being thrown at me from the legacy media and political class are so phony and juvenile; I don't believe that's the way a great nation should be conducting itself, or the way a President of the United States should conduct himself. Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

* Protecting the unborn,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Peter,

I’m Chris Van Hollen, and I’m honored to serve Maryland in the United
States Senate.

Today, I’m also proud to throw my support behind Angela Alsobrooks’s
campaign to join me in the Senate.

If there’s one thing you need to know about Angela, it’s that she knows
how to get results.

I have had a chance, over many years now, to witness firsthand the steady
and stellar leadership of Prince George’s County Executive Angela
Alsobrooks — in both good times and in very tough times.

When you work with Angela, you get a clear sense of what drives her, what
makes her get up every day; what her purpose is. And what moves her is her
passionate commitment to address the real world challenges being faced by
Maryland families every day — and her determination to do everything in
her power to help them succeed.

She understands the conversations happening at kitchen tables across our
state and our country. And when she sees a challenge, she doesn’t back
away. She acts on the wise words of her great-grandmother – don’t sit on
the sidelines; “go farther and do better.”

We can use more of that spirit in the United States Senate,
Peter.

I truly believe that Angela is the best candidate in this race, and that
she’ll fight on behalf of all Marylanders with the same integrity and
can-do attitude that’s defined her career in public service thus far.

name: Harmeet Dhillon
subject: Help us stop Big Tech censorship
body:
Do you trust the government to decide what information is true?

| |
---
| | Fellow American, Do you trust the government to decide what information is true?_I know I don’t._ But state officials have been colluding with Big Tech companies to do exactly that.That’s why we’re suing Twitter and the California Secretary of State. Right now we’re asking the Supreme Court of the United States to hear our case and stop the unholy collusion between Big Tech and the Big Government—collusion aimed to censor American citizens.But we need your help today. **[Which is why I’m asking you to add your name to the Center for American Liberty’s Open Letter standing shoulder-to-shoulder Rogan O’Handley as his landmark First Amendment lawsuit goes before the Supreme Court.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zkl3vurvodtccoggignem9cn7209i1p54qguolg0_rp22sh2s8i66p72chj6ao32cjh2bs)** For years, Big Tech giants have taken their marching orders from the radical Left.And these people think it’s up to them to decide what’s true.They think it’s up to them to decide what you are and aren’t allowed to say, to believe, and to share.And if you dare challenge what they’ve decided is true, they’ll label you an agent of “misinformation” and shut you up._That’s what happened to our client._ If you’re on Twitter or Instagram, you might have heard of him.**His name is Rogan O’Handley, but you might know him as “@DC_Draino.”** And he did what many reasonable Americans did in 2020—he questioned the 2020 presidential election results and called for an audit.That’s when then-California Secretary of State Alex Padilla’s office contacted Twitter employees instructing them to censor Rogan’s tweets.I’m writing to you today because free speech is under attack and I need your help to defend it. **[Will you add your name to the Center for American Liberty’s Open Letter of support for Rogan O’Handley and his First Amendment rights?](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zfvcpftdoooaih8ruhl0jagrp6o6dujo98jgak3o_rp22sh2s8i66p72chj6ao32cjh2bs)** This case is bigger than Rogan and it’s bigger than Twitter. This all happened before Elon Musk bought the platform.If one political party gets to decide what information is allowed in the modern public square, free speech is dead as we know it.**And if politicians can get away with silencing Rogan, they can get away with silencing YOU.** Our attorneys are working around the clock on this case, and we’ve faced some devastating defeats.But we haven’t given up because we know what this case means to the American people.And we’re counting on patriots like you to rally around us right now and support the First Amendment. **[So please add your name to our Open Letter in support of Rogan O’Handley and together let’s put a stop to Big Tech censorship.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zeo88b2r7tcir7400dirrku5n74asleomm1hhk18_rp22sh2s8i66p72chj6ao32cjh2bs)** It’s really quite simple:
---
| | \- If one political viewpoint dictates what’s allowed on social media, free speech ceases to exist in our country\- Without free speech, we can’t have free or fair elections \- Big Tech and Big Government colluding to censor political opponents is a direct infringement of the First Amendment.
---
America as we know it is on the line, and we need conservatives like you to make your voice heard.Thank you in advance for your support.
---
| | Sincerely,
---
---
Harmeet K. Dhillon
---
Founder & CEO
---
|

clean_body: Do you trust the government to decide what information is true? | | | | Fellow American, Do you trust the government to decide what information is true?I know I don’t. But state officials have been colluding with Big Tech companies to do exactly that.That’s why we’re suing Twitter and the California Secretary of State. Right now we’re asking the Supreme Court of the United States to hear our case and stop the unholy collusion between Big Tech and the Big Government—collusion aimed to censor American citizens.But we need your help today. For years, Big Tech giants have taken their marching orders from the radical Left.And these people think it’s up to them to decide what’s true.They think it’s up to them to decide what you are and aren’t allowed to say, to believe, and to share.And if you dare challenge what they’ve decided is true, they’ll label you an agent of “misinformation” and shut you up.That’s what happened to our client. If you’re on Twitter or Instagram, you might have heard of him.His name is Rogan O’Handley, but you might know him as “@DCDraino.” And he did what many reasonable Americans did in 2020—he questioned the 2020 presidential election results and called for an audit.That’s when then-California Secretary of State Alex Padilla’s office contacted Twitter employees instructing them to censor Rogan’s tweets.I’m writing to you today because free speech is under attack and I need your help to defend it. This case is bigger than Rogan and it’s bigger than Twitter. This all happened before Elon Musk bought the platform.If one political party gets to decide what information is allowed in the modern public square, free speech is dead as we know it.And if politicians can get away with silencing Rogan, they can get away with silencing YOU. Our attorneys are working around the clock on this case, and we’ve faced some devastating defeats.But we haven’t given up because we know what this case means to the American people.And we’re counting on patriots like you to rally around us right now and support the First Amendment. It’s really quite simple: | | \- If one political viewpoint dictates what’s allowed on social media, free speech ceases to exist in our country\- Without free speech, we can’t have free or fair elections \- Big Tech and Big Government colluding to censor political opponents is a direct infringement of the First Amendment. America as we know it is on the line, and we need conservatives like you to make your voice heard.Thank you in advance for your support. | | Sincerely, Harmeet K. As the oldest of five kids, I’ve had a lot of practice making things work with very little.
I didn’t grow up with much. My daddy made $26,000 per year, and my mama worked in the home taking care of all of us kids. All the clothes on mine and my siblings’ backs were sewn by-hand by my mama, who — despite the fact that we lived below the poverty level — somehow never made us feel like we were “poor” because we had each other.
She taught us to believe that anything is possible, and it is.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68132402/422050660/-1915233585?refcode=AU_LAC_FR_LAU_GEN_NTL_20230815_PM2_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc2NDYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZTRlM2QzOTUtOTUzYi1lZTExLWEzZjEtMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=mlrW4G1Br13xjtTK_N7QMg2KDMyISTORUBxWKYCUR9w=)
My primary goal in high school was to work and save enough money to buy my dream car: a (used) 1998 Honda Civic. I worked hard and saved my money for two summers and was able to buy my dream car. To pay for college, I worked full-time as a receptionist at a car dealership, and doubled as a waitress at night to put gas in that dream car.
After college, I decided to go to law school — and it was the best decision I ever made. I incurred debt and had student loans after law school, like most folks, but I believed that it would be worth it, and it was.
Out of law school, I started working at the District Attorney’s office, which taught me compassion for others, and about second chances. And it also gave me my first opportunity to start making a difference.
After honing my trial skills at the DA’s office, I started working for a Plaintiff’s Law Firm, which is where I got to spend time working with, for and on behalf of everyday people who had developed cancer through no fault of their own. I learned about the dangers of corporate negligence and malfeasance — and about the importance of protecting workers and their families from carcinogens and dangerous products.
We all know about “cancer alley” in Louisiana. Louisianans have the highest incidence of cancer in the country, which is unacceptable. Louisianans were and still are developing cancers, including lung cancer, lymphomas, mesothelioma and other preventable cancers at staggering rates.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68132403/422050661/-1915233585?refcode=AU_LAC_FR_LAU_GEN_NTL_20230815_PM2_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc2NDYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZTRlM2QzOTUtOTUzYi1lZTExLWEzZjEtMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=mlrW4G1Br13xjtTK_N7QMg2KDMyISTORUBxWKYCUR9w=)
**I have taken the big guys to court in Louisiana — repeatedly. And won. Again. And again. And again.** I’ve worked tirelessly and as a tenacious advocate to bring reparations for the injuries and death my clients have suffered as a result of corporate greed.
I have never represented companies. I represent and fight for people. My clients are and have always been regular everyday Louisianans, who’ve suffered unfathomable inequities and tragedies because no one has tried or cared enough to prevent such. I will continue this fight in the AG’s office for ALL Louisianans.
I have and will never forget my humble beginnings. It is what has driven me to succeed, and to take up the fights for those who need it most. I know what it’s like to feel as though the cards are stacked against you.
**But I’m here to tell you that as a woman who has dedicated her life to fighting for the little guy, anything is possible. And it’s time we realize and work towards that together.**

clean_body: | As a lawyer for the people of Louisiana, Lindsey Cheek’s entire career has been focused on advocating and fighting for clients, causes and people that she believes in. She has consistently delivered results and big jury verdicts for the hardworking everyday folks of Louisiana. Now, she’s taking up the fight for ALL Louisianans and is running to be the FIRST FEMALE Attorney General of Louisiana. With Cheek at the helm, families will have a tried and true lawyer fighting for THEIR safety and for THEIR future. If you’d rather unsubscribe, you can do so here:. = Hi Peter, My name is Lindsey Cheek, and I want to share some exciting news: I’m running to be Louisiana’s first female Attorney General. This is my first time running for office. I am not a politician. I am a Louisiana lawyer, and a pretty dang good one at that! I’m running because this fight is personal to me. Despite having the odds stacked against me, and despite being a working woman in a man’s world, I have succeeded. I am the embodiment of the American Dream. Now, it is my turn to turn around and help others succeed, even in the face of adversity and the incredible odds against you. = | = As the oldest of five kids, I’ve had a lot of practice making things work with very little. I didn’t grow up with much. My daddy made $26,000 per year, and my mama worked in the home taking care of all of us kids. All the clothes on mine and my siblings’ backs were sewn by-hand by my mama, who — despite the fact that we lived below the poverty level — somehow never made us feel like we were “poor” because we had each other. She taught us to believe that anything is possible, and it is. = My primary goal in high school was to work and save enough money to buy my dream car: a (used) 1998 Honda Civic. I worked hard and saved my money for two summers and was able to buy my dream car. To pay for college, I worked full-time as a receptionist at a car dealership, and doubled as a waitress at night to put gas in that dream car. After college, I decided to go to law school — and it was the best decision I ever made. I incurred debt and had student loans after law school, like most folks, but I believed that it would be worth it, and it was. Out of law school, I started working at the District Attorney’s office, which taught me compassion for others, and about second chances. And it also gave me my first opportunity to start making a difference. After honing my trial skills at the DA’s office, I started working for a Plaintiff’s Law Firm, which is where I got to spend time working with, for and on behalf of everyday people who had developed cancer through no fault of their own. I learned about the dangers of corporate negligence and malfeasance — and about the importance of protecting workers and their families from carcinogens and dangerous products. We all know about “cancer alley” in Louisiana. Louisianans have the highest incidence of cancer in the country, which is unacceptable. Louisianans were and still are developing cancers, including lung cancer, lymphomas, mesothelioma and other preventable cancers at staggering rates. = I have taken the big guys to court in Louisiana — repeatedly. And won. Again. And again. And again. I’ve worked tirelessly and as a tenacious advocate to bring reparations for the injuries and death my clients have suffered as a result of corporate greed. I have never represented companies. I represent and fight for people. My clients are and have always been regular everyday Louisianans, who’ve suffered unfathomable inequities and tragedies because no one has tried or cared enough to prevent such. I will continue this fight in the AG’s office for ALL Louisianans. I have and will never forget my humble beginnings. It is what has driven me to succeed, and to take up the fights for those who need it most. I know what it’s like to feel as though the cards are stacked against you. But I’m here to tell you that as a woman who has dedicated her life to fighting for the little guy, anything is possible. And it’s time we realize and work towards that together. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | = = | = = | = = This campaign is bigger than just one person. It’s about building a Louisiana we all can be proud of. I’m ready to roll up my sleeves and get to work. Thank you for your support. Let’s Geaux! — Lindsey Cheek P.S. That 1998 Honda Civic stayed with my family through all five kids, racking up more than 300,000 miles. I don’t think we’ll put in that many miles in these next few weeks, but my team and I will give it a shot. If you can,= Lindsey Cheek for Attorney General PO Box 13035 New Orleans, LA 70185 United States | mailto:info@lindseycheekforag.com | Paid for by Lindsey Cheek for AG

body:
I'm stunned there isn’t more outrage from the conservative professional class in DC. | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/citizensrenewingamerica.com/were-on-the-offensive-10385719?e=17913c7d6d)

| | |

| | | Friends,

My friend and Center for Renewing America colleague, **Jeffrey Clark, was indicted alongside President Trump** and 17 others in Georgia as part of a 2020 election case.

_Jeff was serving President Trump honorably_ and doing his job in 2020, and because of that he’s now facing charges from a radical prosecutor who aspires to higher office and is using this witch hunt to climb the political ladder.

Friends, that’s why I'm personally asking for your help.

**[A donation of $25, $50, $100 or whatever you can afford](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=60b9d6818d&e=17913c7d6d) **would go a very long way in helping the Center stand by Jeff against these phony charges and political witch hunt.
---
| [ ](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=a5afe3bdad&e=17913c7d6d)
---
| **[Yes I'm asking for your support](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=3b616d683f&e=17913c7d6d)** , but this is _not_ _another fundraising email_.

Frankly, I'm stunned there isn’t more outrage from the conservative professional class in DC. They have no idea what an existential threat this is to our country. They are blinded by their Trump Derangement Syndrome and comfortable lives. This type of cowardice institutionalism is exactly why we need new conservative institutions, like The Center and others unafraid to take the fight to the enemy.

_Mark my words_ : we will no longer have a country when men like Jeff have their name dragged through the mud, home raided by the DOJ, and now face criminal charges all because they fought for the integrity of our elections.

You can read our full statement on the sham charges brought against Jeff [here](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=1916f89a2a&e=17913c7d6d).

In the meantime, [**I do hope you will support and stand by Jeffrey Clark**](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=6ebc53777f&e=17913c7d6d). It’s a long road ahead, but Jeff isn’t backing down, so neither can we.
---
| Sincerely,

Russ Vought
President, Center for Renewing America

body:
I promise I’ll be quick.

Peter – I wanted to forward my team’s email from the other day because tonight is the deadline for our **Fight Back Fund** , but we’re still short of our $20,000 goal. Look, I’ll be honest: I don’t like asking folks for money, but I can’t afford not to at this stage in the race. While the GOP field goes on and on about culture wars to distract from the real issues, working folks on the ground are wondering how they’ll afford rent, basic goods and necessities, and their health care. **Louisiana deserves better — we need a governor who will cut through that noise and _deliver_ on the kitchen table issues!** I know we can win with enough support, but it’s going to take _all_ of us jumping off the sidelines to make it happen. So please, chip in anything you can before midnight to help close the gap in our **Fight Back Fund** :******_[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sw-bax-em?refcode=FightBackFund](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68134201/422056820/218720461?refcode=ea.66a64ec6-993b-ee11-a3f1-00224832eb73&ms=ea.66a64ec6-993b-ee11-a3f1-00224832eb73&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDQzOTkiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNjZhNjRlYzYtOTkzYi1lZTExLWEzZjEtMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=AVwqZVm2jfOccZhbw8vsinlfHbegwYPJNpX2rwFOedM=)_** Thank you! \- Shawn Wilson

**From:** Team Wilson
**Date:** Aug 11, 2023
**Subject:** If you read just one email from us, Peter
> Peter – Shawn’s name is officially on the gubernatorial ballot here in Louisiana, and you know what that means: _The fight is on._ For safer communities. For more affordable housing and health care access. For higher wages and a stronger state economy. For a state government that will prioritize families and workers instead of politicized culture wars. body:
Immediately after, Trump and his Fox News allies launched a blitz campaign to discredit the charges.
# [](https://act.couriernewsroom.com/go/83?t=1&akid=1396%2E120351%2ETgKTm4)
Peter —
Late last night, Donald Trump was indicted for the 4th time this year. This time, for an alleged plot to overturn the 2020 Georgia election results.
Before the news even officially broke about the indictment, Fox News was in full **meltdown mode**. Throughout their primetime coverage, Fox News hosts and guests relentlessly attacked the indictment as political, using apocalyptic terms about the future of American democracy.
Senator Lindsay Graham even seemed to threaten political retaliation saying, “To my Democratic friends: be careful what you wish for.”
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-courier-20230815?refcode=em20230815&amount=5&refcode2=1396_120351_TgKTm4&akid=1396%2E120351%2ETgKTm4)
Peter, we know Fox’s end game. By attacking the judicial system and spreading disinformation, they prop up Trump’s political chances and keep ratings and profits high. **It’s the same playbook they used in 2016 to get Trump elected and in 2020, when they pushed Trump’s lie that Joe Biden and Democrats stole the election.**
[**At Courier, we fight back against Fox News by reporting the truth. Will you please chip in $5 to support our work?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-courier-20230815?refcode=em20230815&amount=5&refcode2=1396_120351_TgKTm4&akid=1396%2E120351%2ETgKTm4)

* A 600% increase in identity theft

* And a 300% increase in attacks on law enforcement officers like ours have experienced in Prince William County

View the [2019](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001oGdTt01qgKT3zDW1NeRUZ16MAnPdYFR6agkKJDCV2YcmjBXl1Viy1jh6d9-Un7OB75h9v_cW8PcjAsck_KzRiI8_Tn1QyiXgqzNW8kPVc-H1uAG-QEO4coPvfCMDB-T5TVWjX6hS8ht3PF58u3NpSKIGuwsDAJHn77InHx0yztaMbmFLA1Keug==&c=GvLYeEU1xTrF6lVf4odfnKEYplawy40ztb270YTf4yqTq1QxVdofXA==&ch=ByBElykTHRjaFWVRvVIOuawu8gDf-0P7aLBv21GHMZKyoYrCfOqucg==) and [2022](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001oGdTt01qgKT3zDW1NeRUZ16MAnPdYFR6agkKJDCV2YcmjBXl1Viy1jh6d9-Un7OBnY3AjLMPyHXGmWo_nq1T6v2NNbjRtShfjAQQNCXNiu1L_7n_9vhXZ-JyZNN1AW_xW86M3gqR39udpSFuoo2mUB63fpn1EuYNIwbXBavSu5MrPru2VXkC8nTZe_nOI_Wwcr9xpeRrnw1ASGmNc1J48w==&c=GvLYeEU1xTrF6lVf4odfnKEYplawy40ztb270YTf4yqTq1QxVdofXA==&ch=ByBElykTHRjaFWVRvVIOuawu8gDf-0P7aLBv21GHMZKyoYrCfOqucg==) crime reports for comparison.
Mind you, this is all just since Wheeler, her allies on the board, and Ashworth have been setting county policy. This is what Wheeler is leaving behind in Prince William County and a natural consequence of the aforementioned's dangerous policies and decisions.

[Just this past week, we saw two more lives taken in Woodbridge](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001oGdTt01qgKT3zDW1NeRUZ16MAnPdYFR6agkKJDCV2YcmjBXl1Viy1jh6d9-Un7OBE6rKysOPUXoIQqQB6ejobaMS7Z6M69bjqbtCwXzLJMTvB-ROJ0nwVOKPYoBuUaabI37dFtrEPWx9DNA2Hjm1VF0QJrUIpDIFAvvXf8cy0cyQo9ydyJhPzNzYNtMVL_ErlFZIwlGyWKs_CxMNzdGoCl3A34J95I-EjjxYRkzGYccGuw06vpHaFk0EPV0JyzNZTJlXt2EcrZGQAH_4TRc-XV0XSko4xIxvpzJMHQ8A3I9jwJfpOItbXjweeuul9b_FYT5-tmC_dYgurCc4MP1Wxw==&c=GvLYeEU1xTrF6lVf4odfnKEYplawy40ztb270YTf4yqTq1QxVdofXA==&ch=ByBElykTHRjaFWVRvVIOuawu8gDf-0P7aLBv21GHMZKyoYrCfOqucg==). One of the killers had an assault with a deadly weapon charge in Gainesville in December pled down to a misdemeanor by CA Ashworth and her office. [Instead of giving him the felony and 5-20 years in jail he deserved](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001oGdTt01qgKT3zDW1NeRUZ16MAnPdYFR6agkKJDCV2YcmjBXl1Viy1jh6d9-Un7OBPTPezIRMqZ9jkFEDjhYG_XUP_IoXafUYxsmrpBcDvGoolBKI924H1PolN4HXFQI-bhJvQ-KRiaI7_4wIWJ9v7FEn-1Wba0FzcUSoA0T5yq2A0-ldQ_vHChkVeu2lvjSqQ35dJoWP4uk1ej14-KsceSluavQMlKK57oVpkpQ0QfJ3dxzazqUtD482nuPKSwKQ&c=GvLYeEU1xTrF6lVf4odfnKEYplawy40ztb270YTf4yqTq1QxVdofXA==&ch=ByBElykTHRjaFWVRvVIOuawu8gDf-0P7aLBv21GHMZKyoYrCfOqucg==), Ashworth, in her quest for "criminal justice" let him off with a misdemeanor and he was back on the street in two months. Because of this proactive, premeditated decision, a seventeen year old boy was killed this past weekend by a criminal who should have been in jail. [Shot in the parking lot of the Winding Creek community pool](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001oGdTt01qgKT3zDW1NeRUZ16MAnPdYFR6agkKJDCV2YcmjBXl1Viy1jh6d9-Un7OBE6rKysOPUXoIQqQB6ejobaMS7Z6M69bjqbtCwXzLJMTvB-ROJ0nwVOKPYoBuUaabI37dFtrEPWx9DNA2Hjm1VF0QJrUIpDIFAvvXf8cy0cyQo9ydyJhPzNzYNtMVL_ErlFZIwlGyWKs_CxMNzdGoCl3A34J95I-EjjxYRkzGYccGuw06vpHaFk0EPV0JyzNZTJlXt2EcrZGQAH_4TRc-XV0XSko4xIxvpzJMHQ8A3I9jwJfpOItbXjweeuul9b_FYT5-tmC_dYgurCc4MP1Wxw==&c=GvLYeEU1xTrF6lVf4odfnKEYplawy40ztb270YTf4yqTq1QxVdofXA==&ch=ByBElykTHRjaFWVRvVIOuawu8gDf-0P7aLBv21GHMZKyoYrCfOqucg==).
([This is just one example of why longtime former Prince William County CA, Paul Ebert, a moderate Democrat, has endorsed Ashworth's opponent, Matt Lowrey](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001oGdTt01qgKT3zDW1NeRUZ16MAnPdYFR6agkKJDCV2YcmjBXl1Viy1jh6d9-Un7OBMQCywQ2t_4tRaXEcr6Fa4WN2UiUFL7peSPRqQjLY7Gzajm6-QHxzhpYqZ6abRV-adAVyc8OdAin5K3YaC6EHbr7iXwMJQUktAfag5PH82VOQV9yLe57FXJFDpsE7tNuoOH4WW4a6OR1f-QmS4Tl3iUzECgZC_QmA1uE_ET_MAn9fgGm337SZYWuaSxTbf6a2ekISjm9kBxqVM-plYst3Aw==&c=GvLYeEU1xTrF6lVf4odfnKEYplawy40ztb270YTf4yqTq1QxVdofXA==&ch=ByBElykTHRjaFWVRvVIOuawu8gDf-0P7aLBv21GHMZKyoYrCfOqucg==). Ashworth's extreme views when it comes to letting criminals go was a bridge too far).
This wasn't an isolated decision. This has become the norm in Ashworth's office. Clearly, the chickens of the weak-on-crime plea deals regularly cut by our Commonwealth Attorney in addition to the anti-police rhetoric heaped on our officers for years by the board majority are coming home to roost. While violent crime has increased by 70% and homicides have gone through the roof, Wheeler and the majority on the board have voted to cut the percentage of our budget allocated for police and public safety every, single, year.

Every. Single. Year. Despite the fact that they've also taken record tax revenue from you every, single, year.
Enough is enough. As a law enforcement officer, I am sick and tired of our communities being treated like lab rats in Ashworth and the board's dangerous social experiments on crime.
There's only one way we can stop this. To throw those out of power that have enacted the policies and created the environment responsible for these violent, deadly, and dangerous increases in crime.

As a sheriff's deputy and former police officer, I have stood shoulder to shoulder with our brave men and women of law enforcement - proposing to give them pay increases and bonuses (and not just the political election year pay increase they received this year).

I sounded the alarm over Wheeler's objections when I found out we were over 300 officers shy of our own level-of-service-standards to keep Prince William County families safe. A number that is now nearing 400.
(Despite record increases in violent crime, the Prince William Board majority voted against my proposals to add even a handful of more officers. Their budgets have not added one single new police officer to our ranks the last two years in spite of the soaring crime. This tactic is commonly known as "defunding through attrition").
I fought to keep vital programs in place which kept violent criminals behind bars that Wheeler, Ashworth, and their allies on the board gleefully dismantled, resulting in criminals being placed back on the streets.
Look, in many cases, I'm all for second chances and restoration. But the extreme degree Prince William County's elected majority has taken this the last three and a half years is downright irresponsible and it's dangerous (as we've all seen).
In 2019, crime had fallen to a several decades low level in Prince William County. Common sense approaches to criminal justice from Sheriff Hill, Paul Ebert, and a board majority that put victims and safe communities first governed our county.
Of course, this all changed in 2020.
Folks, a 70% increase in violent crime and a projected 200% two-year increase in murders doesn't happen by accident.
It's really hard to do.
But that's exactly what the irresponsibly far-left elected officials in Prince William County have accomplished in this short (though I know it feels longer) period of time.
[With your help](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001oGdTt01qgKT3zDW1NeRUZ16MAnPdYFR6agkKJDCV2YcmjBXl1Viy1nrHM48U6FrUPTsQVrFm4vdRDZwr6xmEDu_ysFNiUCmsa8AW7fWbfmbRZVwpEmac9K2ZPHKt038ZTMHH1OgHJdCDf6E9Ta4Ngxgx26x27c_5t_9hYPkJRW_du65C1X5o94ORHQfCZCSo&c=GvLYeEU1xTrF6lVf4odfnKEYplawy40ztb270YTf4yqTq1QxVdofXA==&ch=ByBElykTHRjaFWVRvVIOuawu8gDf-0P7aLBv21GHMZKyoYrCfOqucg==), we will restore common-sense law and order back to Prince William County. Putting victims and families first, and violent criminals back where they belong.
[Your generous support today](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001oGdTt01qgKT3zDW1NeRUZ16MAnPdYFR6agkKJDCV2YcmjBXl1Viy1nrHM48U6FrUPTsQVrFm4vdRDZwr6xmEDu_ysFNiUCmsa8AW7fWbfmbRZVwpEmac9K2ZPHKt038ZTMHH1OgHJdCDf6E9Ta4Ngxgx26x27c_5t_9hYPkJRW_du65C1X5o94ORHQfCZCSo&c=GvLYeEU1xTrF6lVf4odfnKEYplawy40ztb270YTf4yqTq1QxVdofXA==&ch=ByBElykTHRjaFWVRvVIOuawu8gDf-0P7aLBv21GHMZKyoYrCfOqucg==) will help us to continue to expose the truth about what has happened to our beloved Prince William County over the last three and a half years.
Safety is paramount to the quality of life we all deserve and desire here in Prince William. Getting crime under control isn't rocket science. It's been done before and simply requires the will to do it and elected officials who don't see it as their job to cut police budgets and put criminals first.
[Join us today to take back Prince William County and reclaim safe communities for our residents](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001oGdTt01qgKT3zDW1NeRUZ16MAnPdYFR6agkKJDCV2YcmjBXl1Viy1nrHM48U6FrUPTsQVrFm4vdRDZwr6xmEDu_ysFNiUCmsa8AW7fWbfmbRZVwpEmac9K2ZPHKt038ZTMHH1OgHJdCDf6E9Ta4Ngxgx26x27c_5t_9hYPkJRW_du65C1X5o94ORHQfCZCSo&c=GvLYeEU1xTrF6lVf4odfnKEYplawy40ztb270YTf4yqTq1QxVdofXA==&ch=ByBElykTHRjaFWVRvVIOuawu8gDf-0P7aLBv21GHMZKyoYrCfOqucg==).
For Coles,

She and her allies claim PWC is merely caught up in a "nationwide trend." Excuse me? 1. The nation == (which has only increased in 2023) like Prince William County. 2. The nation hasn't experienced year to year records in homicides like Prince William County, which is set to shatter last year's record by 50%! The rest of the nation hasn't seen: A full 100% increase (doubling) in aggravated assault A 70% increase in motor vehicle theft Robberies and animal cruelty increase by 50% A 40% increase in thefts A 600% increase in identity theft And a 300% increase in attacks on law enforcement officers like ours have experienced in Prince William County View the == and == crime reports for comparison. Mind you, this is all just since Wheeler, her allies on the board, and Ashworth have been setting county policy. This is what Wheeler is leaving behind in Prince William County and a natural consequence of the aforementioned's dangerous policies and decisions. ==. One of the killers had an assault with a deadly weapon charge in Gainesville in December pled down to a misdemeanor by CA Ashworth and her office. ==, Ashworth, in her quest for "criminal justice" let him off with a misdemeanor and he was back on the street in two months. Because of this proactive, premeditated decision, a seventeen year old boy was killed this past weekend by a criminal who should have been in jail. ==. (==. Ashworth's extreme views when it comes to letting criminals go was a bridge too far). This wasn't an isolated decision. This has become the norm in Ashworth's office. Clearly, the chickens of the weak-on-crime plea deals regularly cut by our Commonwealth Attorney in addition to the anti-police rhetoric heaped on our officers for years by the board majority are coming home to roost. While violent crime has increased by 70% and homicides have gone through the roof, Wheeler and the majority on the board have voted to cut the percentage of our budget allocated for police and public safety every, single, year. Every. Single. Year. Despite the fact that they've also taken record tax revenue from you every, single, year. Enough is enough. As a law enforcement officer, I am sick and tired of our communities being treated like lab rats in Ashworth and the board's dangerous social experiments on crime. There's only one way we can stop this. To throw those out of power that have enacted the policies and created the environment responsible for these violent, deadly, and dangerous increases in crime. As a sheriff's deputy and former police officer, I have stood shoulder to shoulder with our brave men and women of law enforcement - proposing to give them pay increases and bonuses (and not just the political election year pay increase they received this year). I sounded the alarm over Wheeler's objections when I found out we were over 300 officers shy of our own level-of-service-standards to keep Prince William County families safe. A number that is now nearing 400. (Despite record increases in violent crime, the Prince William Board majority voted against my proposals to add even a handful of more officers. Their budgets have not added one single new police officer to our ranks the last two years in spite of the soaring crime. This tactic is commonly known as "defunding through attrition"). I fought to keep vital programs in place which kept violent criminals behind bars that Wheeler, Ashworth, and their allies on the board gleefully dismantled, resulting in criminals being placed back on the streets. Look, in many cases, I'm all for second chances and restoration. But the extreme degree Prince William County's elected majority has taken this the last three and a half years is downright irresponsible and it's dangerous (as we've all seen). In 2019, crime had fallen to a several decades low level in Prince William County. Common sense approaches to criminal justice from Sheriff Hill, Paul Ebert, and a board majority that put victims and safe communities first governed our county. Of course, this all changed in 2020. Folks, a 70% increase in violent crime and a projected 200% two-year increase in murders doesn't happen by accident. It's really hard to do. But that's exactly what the irresponsibly far-left elected officials in Prince William County have accomplished in this short (though I know it feels longer) period of time. ==, we will restore common-sense law and order back to Prince William County. Putting victims and families first, and violent criminals back where they belong. == will help us to continue to expose the truth about what has happened to our beloved Prince William County over the last three and a half years. Safety is paramount to the quality of life we all deserve and desire here in Prince William. Getting crime under control isn't rocket science. It's been done before and simply requires the will to do it and elected officials who don't see it as their job to cut police budgets and put criminals first. ==. body:
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68136085/422062688/-1787004069?refcode=header&amount=25&&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS8xMDAzNTUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOTY0ODRjYjgtOWUzYi1lZTExLWEzZjEtMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=1zc8BB5_J8eVMglhGyg4clX_28qX5qxr6NcUvVx6SP4=) | **The backbone of our democracy relies on the dedication and hard work of election workers and officials. They ensure that our elections are fair, accessible, and reflect the will of the people. But their vital role is under threat.** As Secretary of State, I have witnessed firsthand the challenges that our election workers face; the rise of online and offline threats, fueled by the false claims about the 2020 presidential election. Hi team,

Corporate greed and inaction by our elected leaders are destroying the climate and endangering people across the planet.

The devastation we’re seeing in Maui is heartbreaking, and unfortunately this unfolding tragedy is only the most recent example of the destructive impact of continuing to burn fossil fuels. Extreme weather events like floods, record heat, wildfires, droughts, and stronger storms are getting worse and happening more frequently. Everyone is feeling the effects changing climate. Will this be our new “normal?” It doesn’t have to be if we act now.

**The people of Maui are hurting.** The cataclysmic fires that have **left molten skeletons where structures and cars once stood** , over at least **1,000 missing individuals** , _at least 100 deaths_ and **$5.6 billion in damage SHOULD BE** countered with a **BOLD** response by our **Commander in Chief. **

**Instead, Joe Biden is demanding another $24 BILLION for UKRAINE, while setting off for the second part of his vacation here in Nevada!**

**Unacceptable!**

**So, Friend, I want to humbly ask you right now if you 'll stand with me in my fight for the America we all once knew and loved. **

body:
Honor our troops with effective policy and strong leadership |
---
| |
---
| | Dear Friends and Neighbors,

On this day two years ago, Taliban fighters entered Afghanistan’s capital city of Kabul and seized power with little resistance. Over the next two weeks, the world would witness the tragic and chaotic withdrawal of U.S. forces, including the death of 13 American service members.

It was a low point in recent American history. The United States had invested 20 years in Afghanistan, and the uniformed men and women who returned again and again to that help that desolate country deserved a better outcome. So did our Afghan allies who risked their lives to help our cause.

More than any other event, this experience profoundly affected the men and women I know who served in the Afghanistan war. I remember addressing my airmen after the botched withdrawal to remind them of two essential truths: we kept our country safe, and we brought the terrorists to justice. Those were our missions in Afghanistan, and our military achieved them both. I told them I was proud to be an Afghanistan War veteran, and they should be too.

Here’s what I wrote about those events in the [Morning Call](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=d59f2822a4&e=1090c5c412) soon after they occurred:

“[H]onor our troops with effective policy and strong leadership. Give them what they need to win our nation’s wars. Never put them in harm’s way without a clear and achievable mission. And always bring them home when the job is done.”

If you send me to Congress, that’s exactly what I’ll do.

**Keep America Free.**

clean_body: Honor our troops with effective policy and strong leadership | | | | | Dear Friends and Neighbors, On this day two years ago, Taliban fighters entered Afghanistan’s capital city of Kabul and seized power with little resistance. Over the next two weeks, the world would witness the tragic and chaotic withdrawal of U.S. forces, including the death of 13 American service members. It was a low point in recent American history. The United States had invested 20 years in Afghanistan, and the uniformed men and women who returned again and again to that help that desolate country deserved a better outcome. So did our Afghan allies who risked their lives to help our cause. More than any other event, this experience profoundly affected the men and women I know who served in the Afghanistan war. I remember addressing my airmen after the botched withdrawal to remind them of two essential truths: we kept our country safe, and we brought the terrorists to justice. Those were our missions in Afghanistan, and our military achieved them both. I told them I was proud to be an Afghanistan War veteran, and they should be too. Here’s what I wrote about those events in the soon after they occurred: “[H]onor our troops with effective policy and strong leadership. Give them what they need to win our nation’s wars. Never put them in harm’s way without a clear and achievable mission. And always bring them home when the job is done.” If you send me to Congress, that’s exactly what I’ll do. | | FROM THE DESK OF ALAN DERSHOWITZ
---
| | Dear Sun Reader,
---
| | In over sixty years in the legal profession, I’ve experienced first hand the impact of both good journalism and bad journalism — mostly the latter — and just how important and rare it is to get things right.

In today’s media landscape there are far too many publications that get things wrong. Many are more concerned with the political implications of a story than the basic facts.

The New York Sun is different. It’s a paper that places principle over politics and people over party.

Its in-depth coverage of the legal challenges faced by President Trump serve as a case in point.

When I defended President Trump during his first impeachment, I faced an avalanche of criticism, but few papers made sufficient effort to fully appreciate the significance of the legal arguments.

The Sun’s deeply knowledgeable leadership, including its editor Seth Lipsky and associate editor A.R. Hoffman are themselves students of the Constitution. It shows in their coverage, which I find to be first rate.

It will be no secret to you that I don’t agree with everything that can be found in the Sun’s pages, but I can say with confidence that its re-emergence is among the most important recent developments in American journalism.

I’ve been impressed by the Sun’s growth so far, but I know it faces an uphill battle, one that I have pledged to join.

The Sun’s success will be a gift to the American people and to the cause of truth. But to succeed, we need you to join us. I highly encourage you to join the Sun today.

Every person matters in this effort.

Don’t wait. The battle to restore American journalism starts now.

We must learn from and teach the truth about our past—and how it informs our present. Centuries of disinvestment in Black communities, and systemic racism in our institutions, have led to continually widening inequities. Today, Black households only have a fraction of the wealth that white households have, which is crucial for surviving and thriving.

body:
Do you trust the government to decide what information is true?

| |
---
| | Fellow American, Do you trust the government to decide what information is true? _I know I don 't._ But state officials have been colluding with Big Tech companies to do exactly that. That's why we're suing Twitter and the California Secretary of State. Right now we're asking the Supreme Court of the United States to hear our case and stop the unholy collusion between Big Tech and the Big Government--collusion aimed to censor American citizens. But we need your help today. **[Which is why I'm asking you to add your name to the Center for American Liberty's Open Letter standing shoulder-to-shoulder Rogan O'Handley as his landmark First Amendment lawsuit goes before the Supreme Court.](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=ccb28ce963944a22ae1d32361038fada&_e=rA_Nm4ypqkUUqSF4aQHWJ3orEEqeT1afvy6d9jNN_sjMbMtwCcaQSuXfzPXuQupwCKjR_O2Cn8bsFRXUWama3k9pEpxW8d8ZnqLTniNxyEwAAa0x0AeFS_cYA0GaBhOF703bijdG9yE0G0JCDw27Y322gOMubM-Pex6EHAxDEpYnM4IfESPrm9rZHQZ6y-N1r70lPdR0ZOEPEua3yOd1Dyz5j3o0udo4PxMcpe49342pZOaK7AgYEhgjpdCUf3qSSoYrJJQGxnsP2w6PJwaAxks9i1dbsFaC6OXWdJEtjXCOp_0bNzwZ0fBK_hbCNoy96-m_e5ppBQB2Jbt5jK5hMdZqBqMrQJZC6Qgis7Jszp58R9-z7MBoj30YBOYYBG74)** For years, Big Tech giants have taken their marching orders from the radical Left. And these people think it's up to them to decide what's true. They think it's up to them to decide what you are and aren't allowed to say, to believe, and to share. And if you dare challenge what they've decided is true, they'll label you an agent of "misinformation" and shut you up. _That 's what happened to our client._ If you're on Twitter or Instagram, you might have heard of him. **His name is Rogan O 'Handley, but you might know him as "@DC_Draino."** And he did what many reasonable Americans did in 2020--he questioned the 2020 presidential election results and called for an audit. That's when then-California Secretary of State Alex Padilla's office contacted Twitter employees instructing them to censor Rogan's tweets. I'm writing to you today because free speech is under attack and I need your help to defend it. **[Will you add your name to the Center for American Liberty's Open Letter of support for Rogan O'Handley and his First Amendment rights?](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=ccb28ce963944a22ae1d32361038fada&_e=rA_Nm4ypqkUUqSF4aQHWJ3orEEqeT1afvy6d9jNN_sjMbMtwCcaQSuXfzPXuQupwCKjR_O2Cn8bsFRXUWama3k9pEpxW8d8ZnqLTniNxyEwAAa0x0AeFS_cYA0GaBhOF703bijdG9yE0G0JCDw27Y322gOMubM-Pex6EHAxDEpYnM4IfESPrm9rZHQZ6y-N1r70lPdR0ZOEPEua3yOd1DyouZ8DO55xyD7gzyPYXEEdaK3SQaTuWb5xTfRdQnN6yhtqB3lkQNh2Ndz2qJ2IgEanR72yDJburL1oXm5_UniYP8LUhRdgiRHlWaIOM_XNTAN9upY62Bx6YiekOJniUJggzNcG534Ly6raH06oI1j7-GCuTLFaYWO0mirneE5gP)** This case is bigger than Rogan and it's bigger than Twitter. This all happened before Elon Musk bought the platform. If one political party gets to decide what information is allowed in the modern public square, free speech is dead as we know it. **And if politicians can get away with silencing Rogan, they can get away with silencing YOU.** Our attorneys are working around the clock on this case, and we've faced some devastating defeats. But we haven't given up because we know what this case means to the American people. And we're counting on patriots like you to rally around us right now and support the First Amendment. **[So please add your name to our Open Letter in support of Rogan O'Handley and together let's put a stop to Big Tech censorship.](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=ccb28ce963944a22ae1d32361038fada&_e=rA_Nm4ypqkUUqSF4aQHWJ3orEEqeT1afvy6d9jNN_sjMbMtwCcaQSuXfzPXuQupwCKjR_O2Cn8bsFRXUWama3k9pEpxW8d8ZnqLTniNxyEwAAa0x0AeFS_cYA0GaBhOF703bijdG9yE0G0JCDw27Y322gOMubM-Pex6EHAxDEpYnM4IfESPrm9rZHQZ6y-N1r70lPdR0ZOEPEua3yOd1D7cwQHBzpjHeJAuBcHgNVPapd0ZhvyW6NjCqIu5rFYkm8uVz5HsDlXUudhTWFrVMAeNFvwRe0sXVF2kJagJfJ4cqiRPsBNsEQKssZVMETquGSwtEB9qItkrSy0pCnkp77a-5GYVwUMmrOwAyfnsPgk4oE2ZFLgfXRb0sF1NANcjo)** It's really quite simple:
---
| | \- If one political viewpoint dictates what's allowed on social media, free speech ceases to exist in our country \- Without free speech, we can't have free or fair elections \- Big Tech and Big Government colluding to censor political opponents is a direct infringement of the First Amendment.
---
America as we know it is on the line, and we need conservatives like you to make your voice heard. Thank you in advance for your support.
---
| | Sincerely,
---
---
Harmeet K. Dhillon

But state officials have been colluding with Big Tech companies to do exactly that. That's why we're suing Twitter and the California Secretary of State. Right now we're asking the Supreme Court of the United States to hear our case and stop the unholy collusion between Big Tech and the Big Government--collusion aimed to censor American citizens. But we need your help today. For years, Big Tech giants have taken their marching orders from the radical Left. And these people think it's up to them to decide what's true. They think it's up to them to decide what you are and aren't allowed to say, to believe, and to share. And if you dare challenge what they've decided is true, they'll label you an agent of "misinformation" and shut you up. That 's what happened to our client. If you're on Twitter or Instagram, you might have heard of him. His name is Rogan O 'Handley, but you might know him as "@DCDraino." And he did what many reasonable Americans did in 2020--he questioned the 2020 presidential election results and called for an audit. That's when then-California Secretary of State Alex Padilla's office contacted Twitter employees instructing them to censor Rogan's tweets. I'm writing to you today because free speech is under attack and I need your help to defend it. This case is bigger than Rogan and it's bigger than Twitter. This all happened before Elon Musk bought the platform. If one political party gets to decide what information is allowed in the modern public square, free speech is dead as we know it. And if politicians can get away with silencing Rogan, they can get away with silencing YOU. Our attorneys are working around the clock on this case, and we've faced some devastating defeats. But we haven't given up because we know what this case means to the American people. And we're counting on patriots like you to rally around us right now and support the First Amendment. It's really quite simple: | | \- If one political viewpoint dictates what's allowed on social media, free speech ceases to exist in our country \- Without free speech, we can't have free or fair elections \- Big Tech and Big Government colluding to censor political opponents is a direct infringement of the First Amendment. America as we know it is on the line, and we need conservatives like you to make your voice heard. Thank you in advance for your support. | | Sincerely, Harmeet K. Peter, this is a longer email about our veterans. Sadly, I know some people will just delete this email without reading it or look the other way, but I hope you're not one of them. This is very important.

U.S. military veterans have sacrificed so much to protect our nation’s freedom, values and interests around the world. That’s why I believe our government has a duty to ensure veterans receive the care and benefits they deserve.

**And as Ranking Member the House Committee on Veterans’ Affairs, I am hard at work to make sure our government lives up to that duty.

But sadly, our committee found a serious, unique threat to veterans: Veterans are being targeted by violent, right-wing extremist groups for recruitment.**

We’ve also found that on Jan. 6, more than 10% of the insurrectionists had ties to the military. Veteran Ashli Babbitt was even shot dead by police while attempting to break into the House chamber.

| Meet **Mark Walker**

Congressman Mark Walker started his career in finance and, after earning his theology degree, Walker served 16 years as a pastor. In 2014, Walker stepped away from ministry and made a successful run for the U.S. Congress defeating a host of elected politicians. In 2015, Congressman Walker became the first member in an inaugural term to be elected Chair of the Republican Study Committee (RSC) - the largest caucus in Congress with 160 members and a position previously held by Vice President Pence and Congressman Jim Jordan.

In 2018, Walker was elected as Vice Chair of the entire conference, becoming the highest rated conservative to serve in the top four leadership positions in Congress. Walker is also the last member of Congress to secure a floor vote on a balanced budget amendment and led the House on HBCU initiatives winning the United Negro College Fund President’s list award. Congressman Walker served on multiple committees and in 2019, Walker was appointed to ranking member on the Committee on Homeland Security’s Intelligence and Counter-Terrorism’s subcommittee. Walker was co-chair of the bicameral prayer caucus for five years and also won the GOP MVP award as the starting pitcher on the Republican baseball team for the annual charity game.

Congressman Walker was redistricted out of his seat and stepped away from Congress in 2021. Walker ran for U.S. Senate in 2022 and was endorsed by Senators Tim Scott and James Lankford, Gov. Mike Huckabee, Hall of Fame Coach Tony Dungy and more than 200 pastors across North Carolina. Walker is currently the president of a political consulting business called Advancing Hope USA, and advocated for the two North Carolina Supreme Court candidates and 4 North Carolina Court of Appeals candidates through his independent expenditure organization, Win the Courts during this past general election. Congressman Walker and his wife Kelly, a Family Nurse Practitioner and flight trauma specialist, have been married for thirty years and have three children.

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

| | Friend, Air Force veteran David Grusch provided outstanding testimony during our recent [hearing](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=070bd6f51d79447fafb63d612a05d449&_e=-fSllJ82x4y-lk2I4pIamBzqDIfrwph2dRAfI17nm5mLFIRQoeVaNC38RZUavVnWnFNCXCPXYR7dCAcrEi1tn0Cga3ORsk_AfwS0RnvbzFNLhOHkJE5qnWLpQhVvd9ZPxqJ6jgsLhxS1x_GOSlUfDXsaXj75hM0j-e1N2ieX4arSWyfCyKUVAuXLzFUvdkZ1ZeB1MEq7Avv6_yMWoGnnocRSG_QB-kl2sy3CnjEnGCqPi2GdNwnTeTy9vuRH_JPGn8vS7zwkjSFCPET-TnFopUJQqgjFGI2OFD9rd4BWSh8%3D) on unidentified anomalous phenomena (UAPs). First, God bless him for serving our country and keeping us free. He is one of our nation’s heroes and should be treated as such every single day of his life. It isn’t easy to come forward with the information he provided. As I said weeks ago, our men and women in the military are often [mocked and shamed](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=070bd6f51d79447fafb63d612a05d449&_e=-fSllJ82x4y-lk2I4pIamBzqDIfrwph2dRAfI17nm5mLFIRQoeVaNC38RZUavVnWDSQ2OoxTLfPZIydISICeerBevMwT8-6kkIH9PVg2rIPfgaI0TuNhPNNPniTGfzicEaztdHHv1WTTs4WoFq57FfFmoxNg6Z1QgjDoRUY9VIwpFHYBG9zXVyvttNHSmlGe5zVHPpvHPA4D9Qwjlm8UxOnEc437cnQpYuStymJB_4EhF1MhFVb3W2IS6uETMPzQB2Ecpo3rSdH4fsv8bKVLuNnI6p5EspgoWk2492cEW_M%3D) into silence on this topic. David's admission of our possession of [nonhuman biologics](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=070bd6f51d79447fafb63d612a05d449&_e=-fSllJ82x4y-lk2I4pIamKYZsoamvhkPq_PnRrIBSKT0Om5qrBobYyvk5TkrNDOYI0d0Jrt-NzmcGwRhcdNQ8Z6QfrDCiAbGgX1Hp_o48Xgi12ZSc_trIYlpdMluHTHMXuWuAIStuLMXBA8omX-TAF1fHl3fDROruicll2zb0QJinlGtDcqrGwjaZB3PWEDqilqY8dMr8qfTk96E735eUWBkbbnPJXqL4tDu_bnRhpQ%3D) took courage in the face of bureaucratic bullies. Men like David, who dare to challenge the status quo, risked it all to [push for change](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=070bd6f51d79447fafb63d612a05d449&_e=-fSllJ82x4y-lk2I4pIamKkQzwc0qu_Rdj9IiXS4pwkRORP8646jEUFKrTmFzT0NBSrmqEh1ErrDrLsC6uOOH2UAQXbVv3gt5UZG32W7Niv_dZ3AWr_38pIYIyMmy3A-TJ2bFEJTFUsOQHYUnCL2UvSU_Nh1mwgprM9-Yt-9ntitf3drpmtHy6CCf-lJAKzsaNMo02SbRzp7QC8jlV7LyHabYLybaORHlWlEku9k51-K-kL2T_45XzqjyalHkM1tamUhHZT-HdzzzY-Xh0M0BCpxBFJAuoSEo3vmLJl-PJOJZ1xkU757-1bgG8_ALEkl) on UAP matters, and we should celebrate their bravery. Instead, [The Intercept](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=070bd6f51d79447fafb63d612a05d449&_e=-fSllJ82x4y-lk2I4pIamMWP5lEfcufQSTN-ZqZNPrQPkKFW6DfDHUkAVTSMNW8Vi9Vzm3cH-XDnm6k4vrXGTAFhWMuTNaNlN2FOU1cqwf3L4UnvA2r_msFY6hmK3uzrShsduRgrrLZXyiCGL83nrWQjBBYs7wreLvu-szNtIGDnrsw1JV22G7gZNJkUms4YpHWZRM1ai_Ppmo8Ukh-rMl8Jhy1dmliYBoodaiShIuMq8IWO4OAIO9RkEwaSlMTP) chose a different path, opting to publish a piece that delves into his mental health struggles, including his stay at a mental health facility after making suicidal statements. Let me be crystal clear: WE MUST DO BETTER.

[](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=070bd6f51d79447fafb63d612a05d449&_e=-fSllJ82x4y-lk2I4pIamB3_cqM1mSLzlHqVR53SMxfLSa34aV8EnuJRmTSkxSFfCZRdQpm76ve3Vep4V8Cef2i91mIlpzPDrB63I8YcPI0TSE3ra44hj254aGtQxuvl42X45-z-s3c1V3PyckuzeH-ygNpG-sbIg2zvPIxIlXr3tiWhiIbWCNdYAdOW37aBKiqxg54f7rIfr2Kv4AO_FtxynAqYATqmHWORHzii7ycjmszJimUnnUkbMqKEvZzmYhNtVIuwrVX2la3FYw_rfE3VU5LV1slKYhYgGVIUm-8i6NLE5UqQaL1qPi8CttKvKJXwK6c6ilxHN9ScnnGda25IydeYTtmbtEeYelWcSpU%3D)
