| | It makes me sick to see the media attempt to discredit a veteran who struggled with the very real impact of PTSD. Like so many others, David came home from Afghanistan with [unseen wounds](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=070bd6f51d79447fafb63d612a05d449&_e=-fSllJ82x4y-lk2I4pIamB3_cqM1mSLzlHqVR53SMxd-RfYZUhBpPnL7l0BfHtPsXHpmFcdQrSyYoWEQahJ5VVWQTFzw9-I5BjAaXR4AlAeNQnbC2cBJYntiIDXy6rP-V2HL7sOB0x3uvC-mHxkDHA8XuqLjMlhv0n3-rdksecXBbSt-BYu6RxnzB75OYO8jHUiQpU5Sdl9LlaT9_H4MCnQaLF6xUsZEA2yPQQS05ObEHZZDVI1rV4jCyibawhpWnAuNxmLplaFBU4Dq5FlHvhtOwmJ3dhaNNKOHGctp_0ht_tpSV1JvyD7MhFZzjmdD)—and was further affected when one of his closest comrades took his own life. **This attempt to silence David only adds to the existing**[**mental health stigma**](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=070bd6f51d79447fafb63d612a05d449&_e=-fSllJ82x4y-lk2I4pIamP_9G7cxIVmxiOcoSm3VprlJ1aKjfwHlEwAkM-N9vPnN2cmX7gA9ppFJO3vPglO8QQQoh6KjATgOhSy9k0gf98j0Q5xV89SPeXMbQ6a5XrF4uKF_0imymkSXtrcKgRzvLa5AsaXShe3aGSYuedUM2OU3AqPYRQPBByaarfTBdRe-tX51xDCpwO50WDREmR34llhzSrMURasDKPH5E_lWhPybtXq-sdQxoMVDQermhBw9fGSQF69D29fMhUIP8q5xzA%3D%3D)**our nation’s heroes already deal with, and I won’t stand for it.** We sleep soundly each night because men and women like David are all over the world fighting for the principles and freedoms we hold so dear. It is because of them that we can raise our families in the greatest country in the world without fear of persecution or danger on our doorsteps. I am forever grateful to each and every one of them for their service and sacrifice. Attempting to undermine the credibility of a decorated veteran like David only further reveals the desperation of those who want to conceal the truth, but I can promise you this: They will fail. Sincerely, Tim Burchett

Friend,, We’re currently witnessing the deadliest wildfires in over a century as they devastate Maui and Hawai’i. My heart is with the families and friends who have lost their loved ones in this disaster, as well as the communities still actively working to put out the fires and treat the wounded. These climate-related disasters are becoming more frequent, destructive, and expensive to recover from for the communities who face them. We need to make our healthcare facilities more resilient and support frontline workers so people can get the help and care they need when disasters like this strike. As the residents of Maui continue to fight the flames, [please join me in making a contribution to the Hawai’i Community Foundation’s Maui Strong Fund.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68141199/422082245/-387557724?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDMyMDUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNDg4YTMyODItYWYzYi1lZTExLWEzZjEtMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=aygLFKO8B0sHiL16-IBpjVheYJqYHuMcbQibIo0TS64=&emci=28357819-af3b-ee11-a3f1-00224832eb73&emdi=488a3282-af3b-ee11-a3f1-00224832eb73&ceid=9848080) One hundred percent of the proceeds will go towards rapid response and recovery efforts. We can’t afford to watch from the sidelines as communities burn and drown while first responders and hospitals struggle to meet the mounting threats of climate change. By donating to the Maui Strong Fund, you’re helping communities in need of support in the days and weeks to come. In solidarity,Ro

name: Colin Allred
subject: I'm sweating
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Serve America PAC
body:
I'm sweating, friend.
And it's not just because of the Texas heat. It's because August has been really slow for fundraising.
I know, we just reported our record-breaking fundraising numbers and everyone from CNN to FiveThirtyEight says we can win this race.
But our incredible start to this race makes me one of the Republican's top targets in 2024.
Friend, we can't afford to fall short on this (or any) fundraising goal if we're going to power this campaign to victory and bring real change to Texas. So please, split a donation of $20 or whatever you can spare between my campaign and Serve America to help me defeat Ted Cruz. → [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-allred]
Unlike Cruz, I'm not counting on wealthy donors to buy this seat for me because I believe our leaders should be accountable to the people they serve, not special interests.
And listen, Texas is huge – it takes over 11 hours to drive from the Panhandle to the southernmost point.
That means we need way more volunteers, pamphlets, folks knocking doors, and yard signs to win in Texas than it does in other states. And that adds up fast.
So I'm counting on folks like you to step up with $5, $10, or whatever you can spare, to power our massive grassroots campaign and help create the change we know Texans want and need.
Right now, I'm counting on you to help me raise $50,000 by midnight to get back on track. So please, will you split a donation between my campaign and Serve America and help me fire Ted Cruz? → [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-allred]
Thank you so much – and in all seriousness, I hope you are keeping cool amid record-breaking temperatures this summer!
Colin Allred

# Help Me Stop the Invasion
---
|
---
| | |
---
| Friends, We need your help. America is under attack. I have a plan to solve our immigration crisis, but I need your support to earn my spot in the GOP presidential debates. As I explained in my recent [Newsweek](https://larryelder.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6a42253df6197f177f9e13389&id=12e101f4aa&e=0be619cbaa) column, thousands of illegal aliens are crossing the border every day, and due to the lawless “catch and release” policy implemented by the Biden Administration, more than two million people have entered the country illegally. Law enforcement is overwhelmed, and taxpayers are going to be left holding the bag.Democrats just don’t care. They see this as an opportunity to recruit millions of new voters for their side, and they spend more time policing the way we talk about illegal aliens than they do thinking of ways to secure America’s southern border. For far too long, Republicans seeking a good faith compromise have let them hijack the narrative, basing our country’s immigration on politics instead of security.[**With your support, that ends now. I want to take my plan to the American people, but I need your help. Your donation, no matter how small, gets us one step closer to the debate stage, where I can fight for you.**](https://larryelder.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6a42253df6197f177f9e13389&id=e6b9004e55&e=0be619cbaa) My proposal will stop the flow of illegal immigration in its tracks. As president, I would work with states to implement model legislation that makes residing in the United States illegally a felony. The Washington Establishment has failed the American people for too long. My proposal would allow states to solve the illegal immigration problem **THEMSELVES**. As President, I would reimburse states for the cost of enforcing this law and withhold federal funds from states that don’t do their part to stem the tide of illegal immigration. At this moment, our law enforcement is stretched too thin. American citizens already crushed under the weight of Bidenomics are losing out on jobs to illegal aliens, and taxpayers are now shouldered with the unjust burden of paying for it all. You and I both know how deeply unfair and unamerican this really is.If you believe in law and order, you should support a candidate who rejects politics as usual and embraces common sense solutions to our country’s problems. [**Your donation can help us reverse the tide, and reclaim America for hardworking, law-abiding Americans. What can you give today?**](https://larryelder.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6a42253df6197f177f9e13389&id=1a81242a9e&e=0be619cbaa) Standing with you,
Larry Elder
---
[**P.S. The Washington elite live far away from the crisis at our nation’s border, so they turn a blind eye to the devastating consequences it causes. With your support, we can make them see. Your donation of any amount helps our campaign show the political establishment that We the People won’t take it anymore.**](https://larryelder.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6a42253df6197f177f9e13389&id=7d432a87f6&e=0be619cbaa)

| | **URGENT PETITION: Stop toxic pesticides from pushing endangered monarch butterflies closer to EXTINCTION! [Take action now! >>](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1930197?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)** Friend, this isn’t the news that we wanted to share with you today. We thought that some monarch butterfly populations were starting to recover... but it turns out that the presence of the Eastern monarch butterflies in their wintering grounds actually **DROPPED 22%** in just the last year. Monarchs are officially endangered, and these iconic orange and black butterflies are rapidly dying out, with some estimates showing population _**declines of up to 95%**_ since the 1990’s. What’s worse is that this didn’t have to happen, Friend. A key factor in the devastating decline of monarchs is toxic pesticides like Bayer-Monsanto's Roundup. Driven by greed, the corporation continues to push the sales of its flagship product with no regard for the consequences to our pollinators and the planet. [**We MUST demand accountability before it’s too late to save the last endangered monarchs. Will you stand up to Bayer-Monsanto today?**](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1930198?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==) | [SIGN THE PETITION](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1930199?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
Glyphosate, the active ingredient in Roundup, is wiping out milkweed — a vital plant for monarch survival. These plants are where monarchs _reproduce and lay their eggs_ , and it is the _ONLY food source_ for young caterpillars.
One recent study highlighted a frightening fact: _**every single sample of milkweed collected**_ was _**CONTAMINATED**_ with harmful pesticides — **one-third with levels deadly to monarchs.** Young monarchs are hatching on _**toxic pesticide-riddled milkweed**_ ; their first meal may be their last!
The dangers don't end there, Friend. Glyphosate is a probable carcinogen that is also associated with **reproductive harm in humans** , along with disruption of the **gut microbiome, kidney toxicity, and fatty liver disease.** In fact, farmers and homeowners are _**SUING Bayer-Monsanto**_ due to high rates of **non-Hodgkin’s lymphoma** linked to the Roundup they've used on their farms and lawns.
And the most shocking part of all is that Bayer-Monsanto has actually been caught __**LYING**__ to try and __**COVER UP**__ the harms of Roundup — even going as far as to **manipulate science** and **evade pesticide regulations** — despite knowing that the product is **NOT SAFE!** [**Friend, are you going to let Bayer-Monsanto get away with its dangerous lies that are threatening monarchs, people, and the planet? Or can we count on you to step up right now and fight back against Big Ag’s corporate greed?**](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1930200?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)

| Hi there,

Our home state of Michigan is central to former president Trump’s most recent indictment. Step one of Trump’s plan to steal the 2020 election was to overturn the results in Michigan. These recent indictments are a salient reminder that we only narrowly avoided a true crisis of our democracy in 2020. It also reminds me that thanks to a few key districts narrowly voting Democratic, like MI-03, we could deny Trump’s second bid for the presidency.

clean_body: In the latest national polling, we've had the biggest bump. | | Peter, our message is working. Americans are HUNGRY for a purpose. That's why we've seen the largest bump this summer in polling. In fact, the latest national polling has me up SIX POINTS, and now statistically tied for second place. We're polling ahead of career politicians and the DC establishment. This is our chance, Peter. I'm running to revive our American national identity, but I need your help to make sure we stay on track. Washington doesn't like that we're bucking against what's expected from a candidate or a presidential campaign. I am not a career politician. I am not bought and sold by a Super PAC. I've invested my own money in this race because I believe America is on the brink and we must do something TODAY to change course. We don't have 20 years left. Some stand for incremental reform - I stand for revolution. | It's time for The Great Uprising to defeat The Great Reset. This isn't just an R vs. D question in 2023. It's a 1776 moment. Together, we'll win back the White House next November. Thanks, Vivek Ramaswamy GET TO KNOW VIVEK: Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam , along with his second book, Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence. He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution. Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved. In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Fellow American, As a loyal supporter of my campaign, I wanted to take the time today to reach out to you personally.
In just a few short years, Florida has gone from a swing state to a Republican stronghold, leading the nation in effective, principled governance based on fiscal and constitutional conservatism.
We’ve taken back our schools, driven ideological extremists out of our government, fought to secure our borders, and given Florida’s brave emergency personnel the support they need to keep Americans safe.
It is because of people like you that any of this was possible and for that, you have my sincere gratitude and respect.
However, out-of-state Democrats are terrified that Republicans’ successes in Florida will go national, which is why they intend to spend millions attacking the Florida delegation.

[https://als-totem.s3.amazonaws.com/core/spacer.gif] This is incredible news, friends! So today, as we celebrate, I'm personally asking you to help me keep up our momentum: Will you split $5 or more between myself and Kirsten Gillibrand to defend Ohio's Democratic seat and our pro-choice Senate majority? | | | Peter — Our hearts are broken over the devastation of Maui after a wildfire swept through the island, destroying countless homes and communities, including historic Lahaina, once the former capital of the Hawaiian kingdom. Decades of climate pollution and colonial greed contributed to the deadliest wildfire in more than 100 years after drought and hurricane winds resulted in a perfect storm of death and destruction. Now, as the death toll nears 100 lives tragically lost, with many more still missing, land grabbers are preying on desperate families who have lost everything. We must band together to help rebuild a Maui that works for everyday, local people — kānaka maoli and kama'āina — and rise against the big money and special interests who have created this mess. **Our friends at Our Hawaii Action have created the Maui Community Power Recovery Fund to provide direct relief and long-term recovery to help the people of Maui rebuild and ensure that Hawaiian lands remain in Hawaiian hands.** **[Will you chip in to support direct relief, community organizing, and power-building efforts in Maui? clean_body: | | | Peter — Our hearts are broken over the devastation of Maui after a wildfire swept through the island, destroying countless homes and communities, including historic Lahaina, once the former capital of the Hawaiian kingdom. Decades of climate pollution and colonial greed contributed to the deadliest wildfire in more than 100 years after drought and hurricane winds resulted in a perfect storm of death and destruction. Now, as the death toll nears 100 lives tragically lost, with many more still missing, land grabbers are preying on desperate families who have lost everything. We must band together to help rebuild a Maui that works for everyday, local people — kānaka maoli and kama'āina — and rise against the big money and special interests who have created this mess. Our friends at Our Hawaii Action have created the Maui Community Power Recovery Fund to provide direct relief and long-term recovery to help the people of Maui rebuild and ensure that Hawaiian lands remain in Hawaiian hands. Let us come together as a community and show the true spirit of aloha. Mahalo for your kindness and compassion, Working Families Party Thoughts? Feedback? We want to hear it. **GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. body:
We need you to chip in $3 before midnight.
#

Peter -
At midnight tonight, we’ll be halfway to our next FEC deadline.
These mid-month goals are always important, but this one especially. We hope you’ll give us a minute to explain why.
We’re working hard to show that this is a campaign that can go the distance and win, no matter who our opponent ends up being.
We have to convince a lot of people of that — including important people in the Democratic Party. People who will endorse Ruben. People who will come to Arizona and campaign for Ruben. People who can raise money for Ruben.
They’re looking for signs of strength from us, and one of them is the fundraising numbers we put up at our FEC deadlines. The stronger the number, the more likely it is that people will back Ruben.
And like we said before, this mid-month deadline is also the halfway point to our next FEC deadline. Potential endorsers will be looking when we put out our numbers.
But it’s a good thing they can’t see those numbers today, because we’ve fallen behind.
We have to change that. Time is running out and our window to turn it around is closing, so please:
[**We are humbly asking you to make a donation of $3 before midnight. $3 from you and thousands of others today will get us where we need to be. It all adds up when we’re all chipping in.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-aug23.NWxa9e&refcode=em230815-2-f&t=1&akid=942%2E734936%2EqtrsKq)

body:
Before the day is over, we’re hoping to get a few more signatures.
#
Hi Derek,
Did you see this message from Gisele? It’s John’s birthday 🎉 and before the day is over, we’re hoping to get a few more signatures on his birthday card.
**[Click here to sign John’s birthday card and wish him a happy birthday-- it takes just one minute!](https://act.johnfetterman.com/sign/jf-email-happy-bday-john-2023/?t=1&akid=8506%2E434096%2E8TbqtA)**
Thanks for being part of our team, Derek. 🙏
Together,
Team Fetterman
\--------Forwarded message--------
Sender: Gisele Barreto Fetterman
Date: Tue, Aug 15, 2023 at 1:32 PM
Subject: “Showing João all the love ❤️”
Hey Derek!
I'm emailing you today with an important question: **[Can you sign our birthday card for João? His birthday is today, August 15, so make sure to sign the card now so we can get as many signatures as possible!](https://act.johnfetterman.com/sign/jf-email-happy-bday-john-2023/?t=2&akid=8506%2E434096%2E8TbqtA)**
**[Sign the card »](https://act.johnfetterman.com/sign/jf-email-happy-bday-john-2023/?t=3&akid=8506%2E434096%2E8TbqtA)**
Besides cutting off his head in his birthday photograph ... 😝 I figured I *should* also do something nice for him. ❤️
In all seriousness, this year has been a wild ride of ups and downs and through it all having the support of not only our family and friends, but all of you, has made all the difference.
The incredible amount of support for João, his vision for Pennsylvania, and his human struggles, never stops being surprising and we don't take it for granted for a minute.
I know it'd mean the absolute world to João to see your name on his birthday card card alongside thousands of other grassroots supporters. **The love will be undeniable!**
**[So can I count on you, Derek? Can you take just a minute to sign João's birthday card before we surprise him with it? Together we can make sure this is his most special birthday yet!](https://act.johnfetterman.com/sign/jf-email-happy-bday-john-2023/?t=4&akid=8506%2E434096%2E8TbqtA)**
Thank you thank you thank you,
Gisele ❤️

Hola Peter,
Raquel Terán is running for the open seat in Arizona’s 3rd Congressional District, a Democratic district that will play an outsized role in helping Democrats up and down the ballot get over the line here in Arizona. We need your help to make that happen, so can you please chip in $5 today? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upliftteran?refcode=X_081523_coalitions&amount=5]
The next election probably isn’t on many folks' minds yet, but we already know the stakes are going to be sky high and the results are as close as a coin-flip. Raquel is no stranger to these circumstances. She’s spent her career organizing movements in our state, and helping Democrats win in tough elections like 2020 and 2022. How?
By building big, broad coalitions that include all of us.
That’s exactly the work we are doing right now. Our campaign has earned support from folks like Senator Mark Kelly, Congresswoman Ann Kirkpatrick and important organizations like the Working Families Party, the League of Conservation Voters, LUCHA, and more – on top of dozens of Arizona elected officials and especially community endorsers like you.
We need to build a coalition that spans the entirety of the Democratic Party. It’s how we’ve won before and how we will do it again.
Building winning coalitions takes a lot of work and requires a lot of resources. Please, if you can, contribute $15, $30, what you can to support our efforts today >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upliftteran?refcode=X_081523_coalitions&amount=15]

body:
Bob's got a tough race ahead, and he needs us all on his team.
Hey Peter, it's John Fetterman. Today is my birthday! 🥰
I'm excited to celebrate with my family, but here's my big wish today: **For my buddy Bob Casey to stay in the Senate, fighting for PA families with me.**
Bob's got a tough race ahead, and he needs us all on his team. He has a big fundraising deadline today, so I'm hoping you'll pitch in to his campaign in honor of my birthday.
[**So what do you say, Peter? Can you make a grassroots donation today in support of my friend Bob?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20230815-3?amount=5&refcode=em20230815-3&refcode2=454_552475_uusRP6&akid=454%2E552475%2EuusRP6)

I understand that not every person who reads my emails will choose to donate before Bob's deadline tonight, Peter, but truthfully I'm REALLY hoping you'll be among those who do.
Dollar by dollar, vote by vote, we're going to win this thing with people power. Like I always say: Every county, every vote. 💯
[**If you think protecting our Democratic Senate majority is worth it, please send a donation to Bob Casey's campaign. We're thankful for everybody who can help!**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20230815-3?amount=5&refcode=em20230815-3&refcode2=454_552475_uusRP6&akid=454%2E552475%2EuusRP6)

I would appreciate your support before tonight's mid-month fundraising deadline. Hey Peter,

I wanted to check in with you one last time before our mid-month fundraising deadline at midnight.

We're getting things done for our Commonwealth. We're breaking economic records left and right, attracting businesses, creating new good-paying jobs, fighting for teachers, and rebuilding our communities across Kentucky.

This election is about protecting the progress we've made here at home and continuing to make strides forward. But with less than three months until Election Day, this is still anyone's race.

In fact, this is the most competitive race in the nation this year. That's why my opponent and his allies have announced or spent nearly 10 million dollars on TV attack ads aimed at me.

I'm doing everything I can to ensure we have what we need to fight back, reach Kentuckians across the Commonwealth, and share my vision for another four years of progress. Can I count on your support today?

subject: Our people-powered movement to flip Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Lucas Kunce for Missouri
body:
Let me explain how we got here:
#
We’ve accomplished so much over the last seven months, Peter.
From launching this campaign on January 6th to calling out Josh Hawley on cable news to breaking Missouri fundraising records, your support has helped us put a national spotlight on this U.S. Senate race. And now, we’re nearly halfway through our third fundraising quarter of the year.
In a moment, I’m going to ask you to **[add a donation of whatever you think is best toward our grassroots campaign before our deadline tomorrow.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/35608?refcode=em20230815-3562&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=3562%2E614464%2EUXRCJb) But first, please let me share a little more about how we got here.**
**[ADD A DONATION NOW](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/35608?refcode=em20230815-3562&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=3562%2E614464%2EUXRCJb)**
I grew up in mid-Missouri and, like so many other working families, mine lived paycheck-to-paycheck. So when my little sister was born with a heart condition, the medical bills bankrupted us. Maxed-out credit cards and no money left, times had never been tougher.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/35608?refcode=em20230815-3562&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=3562%2E614464%2EUXRCJb)
But we weren’t alone — our community took care of us. When my parents had to take my sister to the hospital in St. Louis, our neighbors and friends took my siblings and me into their homes and brought more meals by the house than we could ever hope to eat. **That’s the Missouri I grew up in.**
Their support helped send me to college, and after that I joined the Marines to honor everything they had done for me and my family growing up. Got deployed to Iraq and Afghanistan. Later the Pentagon. I was on the Joint Staff negotiating arms control agreements with NATO and Russia.

When I came home between tours in Iraq and Afghanistan, one of the hardest things was seeing what was happening back in my old neighborhood. It was a community picked for parts — the local corner store boarded up, my first family house bulldozed to the ground. **Here’s all that’s left of it:**
